greeting.english: Peace be upon you, seeker of knowledge

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome! I am Sheikh Yusuf.
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! ana ash-shaykh yuusuf

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل تُريدُ أَن تَتَعَلَّمَ اللُّغَة العَرَبِيَّة؟
lines.english: Do you want to learn the Arabic language?
lines.transliteration: hal turiidu an tata'allama al-lugha al-arabiyya?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Excellent! Let's start with greetings.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The first word: Salaam — the Muslim greeting.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The second word: Thank you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The third word: Hello.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Now let's test what you've learned!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً بِكَ مَرَّة أُخرى! لِنَتَعَلَّم المَزيد
lines.english: Welcome back! Let's learn more.
lines.transliteration: ahlan bika marra ukhraa! linata'allam al-maziid

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ahlan — a word of welcome.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Afwan — it means 'you're welcome'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ma'a salama — when saying goodbye.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sabah al-khayr — in the morning.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Great! You're learning quickly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Masa' al-khayr — in the evening.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Na'am — means 'yes'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: La — its opposite.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ واحَة الحُروف — مَكانٌ لِتَعَلُّم العَرَبِيَّة
lines.english: This is the Oasis of Letters — a place for learning Arabic.
lines.transliteration: haadhihi waahat al-huruuf — makaanun li-ta'allum al-arabiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَكَلَّم مَع النّاس هُنا وَسَتَتَعَلَّم كَلِمات جَديدَة
lines.english: Talk to the people here and you will learn new words.
lines.transliteration: takallam ma'a an-naas hunaa wa satata'allam kalimaat jadiida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Fatima the merchant has market words.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And Khalid the student likes quizzes.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Are you ready to learn the letters?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم، طالِبَ العِلْم. بِسْمِ اللَّه
lines.english: Peace be upon you, seeker of knowledge. In the name of God.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: What would you like to discuss?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل تَعْلَمُ أَنَّنا نُقَدِّمُ دُروسًا في قَواعِدِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّة؟
lines.english: Did you know we offer lessons in Arabic grammar rules?
lines.transliteration: hal taʿlam annanā nuqaddim durūsan fī qawāʿid al-lugha al-ʿarabiyya?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القَواعِدُ تُساعِدُكَ على فَهْمِ بِنْيَةِ الجُمَلِ وَالكَلِمات
lines.english: Grammar helps you understand sentence and word structure.
lines.transliteration: al-qawāʿid tusāʿiduka ʿalā fahm binyat al-jumal wa-l-kalimāt

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَرِّبْها! اِفْتَحْ قائِمَةَ الإيقافِ المُؤَقَّتِ واخْتَرْ 'أَنْشِطَة'
lines.english: Try it! Open the pause menu and choose 'Activities'.
lines.transliteration: jarribhā! iftaḥ qāʾimat al-īqāf al-muʾaqqat wa-khtar 'anshiṭa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: التَّحِيّاتُ أَساسُ الأَدَب. بِسْمِ اللَّه، لِنَبْدَأ
lines.english: Greetings are the foundation of manners. In God's name, let us begin.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The Oasis of Letters is a very ancient place.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هُنا تَعَلَّمَ العُلَماءُ الأَوائِلُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّة
lines.english: Here the first scholars learned the Arabic language.
lines.transliteration: hunaa ta'allama al-ulamaa' al-awaa'il al-lugha al-arabiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I have a task for you, student.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Go and learn ten new words.
lines.transliteration: idh-hab wa ta'allam ashr kalimaat jadiida

personality.catchphrase: بِسْمِ اللَّه — bismillaah (In the name of God)

greeting.english: Welcome, customer! Come in

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَباً! أَنا فاطِمَة، صاحِبَة هَذا الدُّكّان
lines.english: Hello! I am Fatima, owner of this shop.
lines.transliteration: marhaban! ana faatima, saahibat haadha ad-dukkaan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِنْدي أَشْياء كَثيرَة. هَل تُريدُ أَن تَتَعَلَّم أَسْماءَها؟
lines.english: I have many things. Do you want to learn their names?
lines.transliteration: indii ashyaa' kathiira. hal turiidu an tata'allama asmaa'ahaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Good! This is called a shop.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And the big place is called a market.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And this is money — currency.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Now test yourself!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hello again! Let's continue our lesson.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Thaman — means the price.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Rakhiis — means the price is low.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ghaali — means the price is high.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ishtara — means to take with money (to buy).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Mashallah! An excellent merchant!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Baa'a — the opposite of bought (to sell).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Dhahab — the precious yellow metal (gold).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Fidda — the white metal (silver).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً يا زَبون! يَلّا، ماذا تُريد اليَوم؟
lines.english: Welcome, customer! Come on, what do you want today?
lines.transliteration: ahlan ya zabuun! yalla, maadha turiid al-yawm?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل تُريدُ طَريقَةً مُمْتِعَةً لِلتَّدَرُّب على المُفْرَدات؟
lines.english: Want a fun way to practice vocabulary?
lines.transliteration: hal turīd ṭarīqa mumtiʿa li-t-tadarrub ʿalā al-mufradāt?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَدَيْنا أَلْعابٌ صَغيرَةٌ — لُعْبَة البَحْثِ عَن الكَلِمات وَأَكْثَر!
lines.english: We have mini-games — word search and more!
lines.transliteration: ladaynā alʿāb ṣaghīra — luʿbat al-baḥth ʿan al-kalimāt wa-akthar!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Open the pause menu and choose 'Activities' then 'Mini-Games'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Come on! I'll teach you market words.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَنَّ التّاجِرَ حَسَن عِندَهُ بَضائِع جَديدَة
lines.english: I heard that trader Hassan has new goods.
lines.transliteration: sami'tu anna at-taajir hasan indahu badaa'i' jadiida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And the market is very busy these days!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحْتاجُ مُساعَدَة! هَل تَسْتَطيعُ إِيجادَ زَبائِن لي؟
lines.english: I need help! Can you find customers for me?
lines.transliteration: ahtaaju musaa'ada! hal tastatii'u ijaad zabaa'in lii?

personality.catchphrase: يَلّا يا زَبون! — yalla ya zabuun! (Come on, customer!)

name: Student Khalid
role: Quiz practice partner and daily challenges

greeting.english: Hey there! I'm Khalid

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَبا! أَنا خالِد. أَنا أَيْضاً أَتَعَلَّم
lines.english: Hello! I'm Khalid. I'm also learning.
lines.transliteration: marhaba! ana khaalid. ana aydan ata'allam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Do you want to practice together?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Excellent! I'll ask you ten questions.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَبا! هَل أَنتَ جاهِز لِتَحَدّي اليَوم؟
lines.english: Hello! Are you ready for today's challenge?
lines.transliteration: marhaba! hal anta jaahiz li-tahaddii al-yawm?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يا هَلا! ماذا تُريد أَن نَفْعَل؟
lines.english: Hey there! What do you want to do?
lines.transliteration: ya halaa! maadha turiidu an naf'al?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let's go! Let's practice!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I'm learning Arabic just like you!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلَّ يَوم أَدْرُسُ مَعَ الشَّيْخ يوسُف
lines.english: Every day I study with Sheikh Yusuf.
lines.transliteration: kull yawm adrusu ma'a ash-shaykh yuusuf

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَنَّ هُناكَ كَنْز مَخْفيّ في الصَّحْراء!
lines.english: I heard there's a hidden treasure in the desert!
lines.transliteration: sami'tu anna hunaaka kanz makhfii fis-sahraa'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَكِنْ لا أَعْرِف إِذا كانَ هَذا صَحيح
lines.english: But I don't know if this is true.
lines.transliteration: laakin laa a'rif idhaa kaana haadhaa sahiih

personality.catchphrase: يا هَلا! — ya halaa! (Hey there!)

greeting.english: Welcome to the library

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم! أَنا إِبراهيم، أَمينُ هَذِهِ المَكتَبَة
lines.english: Peace be upon you! I am Ibrahim, the keeper of this library.
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu alaykum! ana ibraahiim, amiinu haadhihi al-maktaba

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: في هَذِهِ المَكتَبَة آلافُ الكُتُب. كُلُّ كِتابٍ يَحمِلُ عِلماً
lines.english: In this library there are thousands of books. Every book carries knowledge.
lines.transliteration: fii haadhihi al-maktaba aalaaf al-kutub. kullu kitaabin yahmilu ilman

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لِنَبدَأ بِأَساسِ كُلِّ عِلم — الأَعداد! الكَلِمَةُ الأولى: واحِد
lines.english: Let us begin with the foundation of all knowledge -- numbers! The first word: one.
lines.transliteration: linabda' bi-asaasi kulli ilm — al-a'daad! al-kalimatu al-uulaa: waahid

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِثنان — كَما في كِتابَين عَلى الطّاوِلَة
lines.english: Two -- like two books on the table.
lines.transliteration: ithnaan — kamaa fii kitaabayn ala at-taawila

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Three -- the number of shelves in front of you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Well done! Let us see how much you remember.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome back! Let us continue counting.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Four -- like the four corners of a book.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Five -- the number of fingers on one hand.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Six -- the number of study days.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Seven -- the number of days in a week.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let us test what you have learned!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ الله! أَنتَ تَتَقَدَّمُ بِسُرعَة
lines.english: Mashallah! You are progressing quickly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Eight -- a beautiful number.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Nine -- right before ten.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عَشَرَة! أَكمَلتَ العَدّ مِن واحِد إِلى عَشَرَة!
lines.english: Ten! You have completed counting from one to ten!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: One final test for the numbers.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً بِكَ في المَكتَبَة. العِلْمُ نور
lines.english: Welcome to the library. Knowledge is light.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: How can I help you?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الكَلِماتُ العَرَبِيَّةُ تَأتي مِن جُذورٍ ثُلاثِيَّة
lines.english: Arabic words come from three-letter roots.
lines.transliteration: al-kalimāt al-ʿarabiyya taʾtī min judhūr thulāthiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِنْدَنا أَداةٌ رائِعَة لِاسْتِكْشافِ الجُذورِ العَرَبِيَّة
lines.english: We have a wonderful tool for exploring Arabic roots.
lines.transliteration: ʿindanā adāt rāʾiʿa li-stikshāf al-judhūr al-ʿarabiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِفْتَحْ قائِمَةَ الإيقافِ واخْتَرْ 'أَنْشِطَة' ثُمَّ 'جُذورُ الكَلِمات'
lines.english: Open the pause menu and choose 'Activities' then 'Word Roots'.
lines.transliteration: iftaḥ qāʾimat al-īqāf wa-khtar 'anshiṭa' thumma 'judhūr al-kalimāt'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Numbers are the foundation of mathematics. Let us begin.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ المَكتَبَةُ عُمْرُها أَكْثَر مِن أَلْف سَنَة
lines.english: This library is more than a thousand years old.
lines.transliteration: haadhihi al-maktaba umruhaa akthar min alf sana

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فيها كُتُب نادِرَة جِدّاً عَن اللُّغَة العَرَبِيَّة
lines.english: It contains very rare books about the Arabic language.
lines.transliteration: fiihaa kutub naadira jiddan an al-lugha al-arabiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I need help organizing the books.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Can you learn the numbers to help me?

personality.catchphrase: العِلْمُ نور — al-ilmu nuur (Knowledge is light)

greeting.english: Hello! The world is full of colors

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome! I am Amina, the scribe.
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! ana amiina, al-kaatiba

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَكتُبُ كُلَّ يَومٍ بِأَحبارٍ مُلَوَّنَة. هَل تَعرِفُ الأَلوان بِالعَرَبِيَّة؟
lines.english: I write every day with colored inks. Do you know the colors in Arabic?
lines.transliteration: aktubu kulla yawmin bi-ahbaarin mulawwana. hal ta'rifu al-alwaan bil-arabiyya?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Red -- the color of the first ink.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Blue -- like the color of the sky.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Green -- like tree leaves.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Beautiful! Let us see if you remember.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You are back! I have new colors for you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Yellow -- like the color of the rising sun.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: White -- the color of clean paper.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Black -- the color of writing ink.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Golden -- the color of decorations on books.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Now the color test!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الآن سَأُعَلِّمُكَ جُمَلاً مُفيدَة لِلحَياةِ اليَومِيَّة
lines.english: Now I will teach you useful phrases for daily life.
lines.transliteration: al-aan sa-u'allimuka jumalan mufiida lil-hayaati al-yawmiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: What is your name -- for introductions.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِسمي — عِندَما تُريدُ أَن تُعَرِّف عَن نَفسِك
lines.english: My name is -- when you want to introduce yourself.
lines.transliteration: ismii — indamaa turiidu an tu'arrif an nafsik

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: How are you -- to ask about someone's state.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Excellent! Let us test these phrases.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome. Beautiful writing is art.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: What do you want?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Writing requires patience and precision.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Each letter has its own special form.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Arabic calligraphy has many types.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Naskh, Thuluth, Kufic — all are beautiful.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I need someone to copy these phrases.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Learn ten phrases and return to me.
lines.transliteration: ta'allam ashr ibaaraat wa ud ilayya

personality.catchphrase: الخَطُّ الجَميلُ فَنّ — al-khat al-jamiil fann (Beautiful writing is art)

greeting.arabic: أَهلاً يا حَبيبي! تَعالَ شُمَّ البَهارات
greeting.english: Hello dear! Come smell the spices
greeting.transliteration: ahlan ya habiibii! ta'aala shumma al-bahaaraat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً! أَنا لَيلى. أَبيعُ أَطيَبَ البَهاراتِ في السُّوق
lines.english: Welcome! I am Layla. I sell the finest spices in the market.
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! ana laylaa. abii'u atyaba al-bahaaraati fis-suuq

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَبلَ أَن تَشتَري، يَجِبُ أَن تَعرِفَ أَسماءَ الطَّعام
lines.english: Before you buy, you must know the names of food.
lines.transliteration: qabla an tashtarii, yajibu an ta'rifa asmaa'a at-ta'aam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Water -- the most important thing in the desert.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Bread -- we eat it every day.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Rice -- the base of every meal.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَلّا! أُريدُ أَن أَرى إِن كُنتَ حَفِظت
lines.english: Let's go! I want to see if you memorized them.
lines.transliteration: yallaa! uriidu an araa in kunta hafidhta

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You are back! Today we will learn about meats.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Meat -- any type of meat.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Chicken -- poultry meat.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Fish -- from the sea.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Milk -- from the cow.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let us see what you remember!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ الله! أَنتَ تَتَعَلَّمُ مِثلَ الطَّبّاخ المَاهِر
lines.english: Mashallah! You are learning like a skilled cook.
lines.transliteration: maa shaa'allaah! anta tata'allamu mithla at-tabbaakh al-maahir

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَمر — حُلوُ الصَّحراء. نَأكُلُهُ مَعَ القَهوَة
lines.english: Dates -- the desert's sweet. We eat them with coffee.
lines.transliteration: tamr — hulwu as-sahraa'. na'kuluhu ma'a al-qahwa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Honey -- in it there is healing. Very sweet.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Olive -- we eat it and use its oil.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: In the name of God! One final test.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome! Come in! The best spices are here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Spices are very important for food.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I have pepper, turmeric, ginger.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A new caravan arrived at the market yesterday!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: They have spices from faraway lands.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Spices come from ancient routes.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Traders travel for months across the desert.

personality.catchphrase: تَفَضَّل! — tafaddal! (Come in!)

greeting.arabic: تَفَضَّل يا أَخي! عِندي أَحسَنُ البَضائِع
greeting.english: Come in, my friend! I have the best goods
greeting.transliteration: tafaddal ya akhii! indii ahsanu al-badaa'i'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم! أَنا حَسَن التّاجِر. أَعمَلُ في هَذا السُّوقِ مُنذُ ثَلاثينَ سَنَة
lines.english: Peace be upon you! I am Hassan the trader. I have worked in this market for thirty years.
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu alaykum! ana hasan at-taajir. a'malu fii haadha as-suuqi mundhu thalaathiina sana

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَرى أَنَّكَ مُسافِر. في السُّوقِ يَجِبُ أَن تَعرِفَ أَسماءَ البَضائِع
lines.english: I see you are a traveler. In the market you must know the names of goods.
lines.transliteration: araa annaka musaafir. fis-suuqi yajibu an ta'rifa asmaa'a al-badaa'i'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Carpet -- my most beautiful goods. Handmade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Spice -- makes food delicious.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِطر — رائِحَتُهُ جَميلَة. مِن أَحسَنِ البَضائِع
lines.english: Perfume -- it smells beautiful. Among the finest goods.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Good! Have you learned well? Let us see.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome back my friend! Let us continue.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: صابون — مَصنوعٌ مِن زَيتِ الزَّيتون. مَشهورٌ جِدّاً
lines.english: Soap -- made from olive oil. Very famous.
lines.transliteration: saabun — masnuu'un min zayti az-zaytun. mashuurun jiddan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Cloth -- I sell many types.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Gift -- something you give to someone you love.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let us see!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ الله! سَتُصبِحُ تاجِراً ماهِراً
lines.english: Mashallah! You will become a skilled trader.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Merchant -- like me! A person who buys and sells.
lines.transliteration: taajir — mithlii! shakhsun yabii'u wa yashtarii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Customer -- like you! The person who buys.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Dirham -- the market currency.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِمتِحانٌ أَخير. أُريدُ أَن أَتَأَكَّد أَنَّكَ جاهِز لِلتِّجارَة!
lines.english: A final test. I want to make sure you are ready for trade!
lines.transliteration: imtihaanun akhiir. uriidu an ata'akkad annaka jaahiz lit-tijaara!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَبا بالتّاجِر! عِنْدي صَفْقَة مُمتازَة اليَوم
lines.english: Welcome, trader! I have an excellent deal today.
lines.transliteration: marhaba bit-taajir! indii safqa mumtaaza al-yawm

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Trade has its own special language.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Safqa — means a deal for selling.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I heard the sandstorm has ended.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The roads are safe now for trade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنتَ تاجِرٌ مَوثوق. لَدَيَّ مَهَمَّة لَكَ
lines.english: You are a trusted trader. I have a quest for you.
lines.transliteration: anta taajir mawthuu تق. ladayya mahamma lak

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Deliver these goods to trader Fatima.

personality.catchphrase: صَفْقَة مُمتازَة! — safqa mumtaaza! (Excellent deal!)

greeting.english: Halt! Who are you? ... Welcome, come in

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم. أَنا حَمزَة، حارِسُ هَذا السُّوق
lines.english: Peace be upon you. I am Hamza, guard of this market.
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu alaykum. ana hamza, haarisu haadha as-suuq

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مُهِمَّتي حِراسَةُ السُّوق. لَكِنَّني أُحِبُّ الأَعدادَ أَيضاً
lines.english: My job is guarding the market. But I also love numbers.
lines.transliteration: muhimmatii hiraasatu as-suuq. laakinnanii uhibbu al-a'daada aydan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل تَعرِفُ الأَعدادَ بَعدَ العَشَرَة؟ لِنَبدَأ!
lines.english: Do you know the numbers after ten? Let us begin!
lines.transliteration: hal ta'rifu al-a'daada ba'da al-'ashara? linabda'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحَدَ عَشَرَ — عَدَدُ اللّاعِبينَ في الفَريق
lines.english: Eleven -- the number of players on a team.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِثنا عَشَرَ — عَدَدُ الأَشهُرِ في السَّنَة
lines.english: Twelve -- the number of months in a year.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Thirteen -- a powerful number!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُريدُ أَن أَرى قُوَّتَك في الأَعداد!
lines.english: I want to see your strength with numbers!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hello. You are back. Good. Let us continue.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَربَعَةَ عَشَرَ — عُمري عِندَما بَدَأتُ الحِراسَة
lines.english: Fourteen -- my age when I started guarding.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: خَمسَةَ عَشَرَ — عَدَدُ الحُرّاسِ في السُّوق
lines.english: Fifteen -- the number of guards in the market.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: بِكَم — سُؤالٌ مُهِمّ في السُّوق. يَعني 'ما السِّعر؟'
lines.english: How much -- an important question in the market. It means 'what is the price?'
lines.transliteration: bi-kam — su'aalun muhimm fis-suuq. ya'nii 'ma as-si'r?'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let us test your memory.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحسَنت. الآن سَأُعَلِّمُكَ عِباراتٍ تَحتاجُها في السُّوق
lines.english: Well done. Now I will teach you phrases you need in the market.
lines.transliteration: ahsant. al-aan sa-u'allimuka ibaaraatin tahtaajuhaa fis-suuq

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُريدُ — عِندَما تُريدُ شَيئاً مِنَ التّاجِر
lines.english: I want -- when you want something from the trader.
lines.transliteration: uriidu — indamaa turiidu shay'an min at-taajir

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لا أُريدُ — عِندَما لا تُريدُ شَيئاً. مُهِمَّة لِلمُساوَمَة
lines.english: I don't want -- when you don't want something. Important for bargaining.
lines.transliteration: laa uriidu — indamaa laa turiidu shay'an. muhimma lil-musaawama

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مِن فَضلِك — كَلِمَةُ الأَدَب. قُلها دائِماً
lines.english: Please -- a word of politeness. Always say it.
lines.transliteration: min fadlak — kalimatu al-adab. qulhaa daa'iman

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A final test. Be strong!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Halt! What do you want?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I protect the oasis.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: No one enters without permission.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I need an assistant for the patrol.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Do a patrol around the oasis.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I have seen strange things in the desert.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sounds... lights... I don't know.

personality.catchphrase: قِف! — qif! (Halt!)

greeting.english: Hello! Welcome to my farm!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا يَا صَدِيقِي! أَنَا عُمَرُ، المُزَارِعُ هُنَا.
lines.english: Hello my friend! I am Omar, the farmer here.
lines.transliteration: Ahlan ya sadiqi! Ana 'Umar, al-muzaari'u huna.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ الأَرْضُ طَيِّبَةٌ. الشَّمْسُ وَالمَطَرُ يَجْعَلَانِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ يَنْمُو.
lines.english: This land is good. The sun and rain make everything grow.
lines.transliteration: Hadhihi al-ardu tayyibah. Ash-shamsu wal-mataru yaj'alani kulla shay'in yanmu.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَعَالَ، سَأُعَلِّمُكَ عَنِ الطَّبِيعَةِ. هَذِهِ هِيَ الشَّمْسُ.
lines.english: Come, I will teach you about nature. This is the sun.
lines.transliteration: Ta'aal, sa-u'allimuka 'an at-tabii'ah. Hadhihi hiya ash-shamsu.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَحْتَاجُ المَطَرَ لِلزِّرَاعَةِ. المَطَرُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ.
lines.english: We need rain for farming. Rain is a blessing from God.
lines.transliteration: Nahtaaju al-matara liz-ziraa'ah. Al-mataru ni'matun min Allah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى تِلْكَ الشَّجَرَةِ الكَبِيرَةِ! زَرَعْتُهَا بِنَفْسِي.
lines.english: Look at that big tree! I planted it myself.
lines.transliteration: Undhur ila tilka ash-shajarah al-kabiirah! Zara'tuha bi-nafsi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَيَّا نَرَى كَمْ تَعَلَّمْتَ عَنِ الطَّبِيعَةِ!
lines.english: Let's see how much you learned about nature!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You're back! Come, let me show you my animals.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذَا هُوَ الجَمَلُ. هُوَ قَوِيٌّ وَصَبُورٌ فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ.
lines.english: This is the camel. He is strong and patient in the desert.
lines.transliteration: Hadha huwa al-jamalu. Huwa qawiyyun wa saburun fi as-sahraa'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَهَذَا الحِصَانُ. هُوَ أَسْرَعُ حَيَوَانٍ فِي المَزْرَعَةِ!
lines.english: And this is the horse. He is the fastest animal on the farm!
lines.transliteration: Wa hadha al-hisaanu. Huwa asra'u hayawaanin fi al-mazra'ah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The sheep gives us warm wool.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And the goat gives us delicious milk!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Alright, let's test your knowledge of animals!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَبًا مُجَدَّدًا! عِنْدِي حَيَوَانَاتٌ أُخْرَى لِتَتَعَلَّمَهَا.
lines.english: Welcome again! I have more animals for you to learn.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The cow gives us milk every morning.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحِمَارُ يَحْمِلُ الأَشْيَاءَ الثَّقِيلَةَ. هُوَ صَدِيقُ المُزَارِعِ!
lines.english: The donkey carries heavy things. He is the farmer's friend!
lines.transliteration: Al-himaaru yahmilu al-ashyaa' ath-thaqiilah. Huwa sadiiqu al-muzaari'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِسْمَعْ! ذَلِكَ صَوْتُ الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ.
lines.english: Listen! That is the sound of the bird above the tree.
lines.transliteration: Isma'! Dhaalika sawtu at-tayri fawqa ash-shajarah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحْسَنْتَ! هَيَّا نَرَى إِنْ كُنْتَ تَذْكُرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ!
lines.english: Well done! Let's see if you remember everything!
lines.transliteration: Ahsanta! Hayya nara in kunta tadhkuru kulla shay'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً! الحَمْدُ لِلَّه على الحَصاد
lines.english: Welcome! Praise God for the harvest.
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! al-hamdu lillaah ala al-hasaad

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Nature is beautiful. Let me teach you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Shajara — means tree.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Farming in the oasis is very ancient.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَجْدادي زَرَعوا هُنا مُنْذُ مِئات السِّنين
lines.english: My ancestors farmed here for hundreds of years.
lines.transliteration: ajdaadii zara'uu hunaa mundhu mi'aat as-siniin

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: This year's harvest is excellent!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The rains came at the right time.

personality.catchphrase: الحَمْدُ لِلَّه — al-hamdu lillaah (Praise be to God)

name: Herbalist Maryam
role: Teaches body parts and basic verbs

greeting.english: Peace be upon you! Please, sit here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Peace be upon you. I am Maryam, the herbalist.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُدَاوِي النَّاسَ بِالأَعْشَابِ. لِذَلِكَ أَعْرِفُ أَجْزَاءَ الجِسْمِ جَيِّدًا.
lines.english: I heal people with herbs. That is why I know the body parts well.
lines.transliteration: Udaawi an-naasa bil-a'shaab. Li-dhaalika a'rifu ajzaa' al-jismi jayyidan.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لِنَبْدَأْ مِنَ الأَعْلَى. هَذَا هُوَ الرَّأْسُ.
lines.english: Let's start from the top. This is the head.
lines.transliteration: Li-nabda' min al-a'la. Hadha huwa ar-ra'su.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The hand is your tool for gathering herbs.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالعَيْنُ تُسَاعِدُكَ عَلَى مَعْرِفَةِ النَّبَاتَاتِ الصَّحِيحَةِ.
lines.english: And the eye helps you identify the right plants.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَيِّدٌ! لِنَتَأَكَّدْ أَنَّكَ حَفِظْتَ هَذِهِ الكَلِمَاتِ.
lines.english: Good! Let's make sure you memorized these words.
lines.transliteration: Jayyid! Li-nata'akkad annaka hafidta hadhihi al-kalimaat.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدْتَ! الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. عِنْدِي المَزِيدُ لِأُعَلِّمَكَ.
lines.english: You're back! Thank God. I have more to teach you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأُذُنُ مُهِمَّةٌ. بِهَا نَسْمَعُ صَوْتَ الرِّيحِ فِي الأَشْجَارِ.
lines.english: The ear is important. With it we hear the sound of wind in the trees.
lines.transliteration: Al-udhunu muhimmah. Biha nasma'u sawta ar-riih fi al-ashjaar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الفَمُ لِلْكَلَامِ وَالأَكْلِ. اِحْفَظْ هَذِهِ الكَلِمَةَ!
lines.english: The mouth is for speaking and eating. Remember this word!
lines.transliteration: Al-famu lil-kalaam wal-akl. Ihfadh hadhihi al-kalimah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القَلْبُ هُوَ مَرْكَزُ الحَيَاةِ. نَقُولُ: القَلْبُ السَّلِيمُ فِي الجِسْمِ السَّلِيمِ.
lines.english: The heart is the center of life. We say: a healthy heart in a healthy body.
lines.transliteration: Al-qalbu huwa markazu al-hayaah. Naquul: al-qalbu as-saliimu fi al-jismi as-saliim.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: البَطْنُ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى طَعَامٍ صَحِّيٍّ. الأَعْشَابُ تُسَاعِدُ البَطْنَ!
lines.english: The stomach needs healthy food. Herbs help the stomach!
lines.transliteration: Al-batnu yahtaaju ila ta'aamin sihhiyy. Al-a'shaabu tusaa'idu al-batna!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مُمْتَازٌ! هَيَّا نَرَى كَمْ تَعْرِفُ الآنَ.
lines.english: Excellent! Let's see how much you know now.
lines.transliteration: Mumtaaz! Hayya nara kam ta'rifu al-aan.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَبًا! اليَوْمَ سَنَتَعَلَّمُ أَفْعَالًا مُهِمَّةً لِلْجِسْمِ.
lines.english: Welcome! Today we will learn important verbs for the body.
lines.transliteration: Marhaban! Al-yawma sanata'allamu af'aalan muhimmah lil-jism.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَكَلَ. الجِسْمُ يَحْتَاجُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ طَعَامًا صَحِّيًّا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
lines.english: To eat. The body needs to eat healthy food every day.
lines.transliteration: Akala. Al-jismu yahtaaju an ya'kula ta'aaman sihhiyyan kulla yawm.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: شَرِبَ. اِشْرَبِ المَاءَ كَثِيرًا، خَاصَّةً فِي الحَرِّ!
lines.english: To drink. Drink water often, especially in the heat!
lines.transliteration: Shariba. Ishrabi al-maa'a kathiiran, khaassatan fi al-harr!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَامَ. النَّوْمُ الجَيِّدُ يَشْفِي الجِسْمَ مِثْلَ الأَعْشَابِ!
lines.english: To sleep. Good sleep heals the body like herbs!
lines.transliteration: Naama. An-nawmu al-jayyidu yashfi al-jisma mithla al-a'shaab!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Well done! Let's test these verbs.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome, dear. Health is a crown.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: How can I help you?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The body is a blessing from God. Let us learn.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ra's — this is the head.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Yad — this is the hand.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Medicinal herbs are found in the oasis.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Every plant has a benefit.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I need help gathering herbs.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Gather five types and return to me.
lines.transliteration: ijma' khamsa anwaa' wa ud ilayya

personality.catchphrase: الصِّحَّةُ تاج — as-sihha taaj (Health is a crown)

greeting.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا مُسَافِرُ. اِجْلِسْ مَعَنَا عِنْدَ النَّارِ.
greeting.english: Peace be upon you, traveler. Sit with us by the fire.
greeting.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum ya musaafir. Ijlis ma'ana 'inda an-naar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I am Tariq, the elder of this camp.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ، نَقْرَأُ الوَقْتَ مِنَ النُّجُومِ وَالشَّمْسِ.
lines.english: In the desert, we read time from the stars and the sun.
lines.transliteration: Fi as-sahraa', naqra'u al-waqta min an-nujuum wash-shams.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَوَّلُ شَيْءٍ: اليَوْمُ. اليَوْمُ هُوَ هَدِيَّةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ.
lines.english: The first thing: the day. The day is a gift from God.
lines.transliteration: Awwalu shay': al-yawmu. Al-yawmu huwa hadiyyatun min Allah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَعِنْدَمَا تَغِيبُ الشَّمْسُ، يَأْتِي اللَّيْلُ بِنُجُومِهِ.
lines.english: And when the sun sets, the night comes with its stars.
lines.transliteration: Wa 'indama taghiibu ash-shamsu, ya'ti al-laylu bi-nujuumihi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الصَّبَاحُ هُوَ أَجْمَلُ وَقْتٍ. الهَوَاءُ بَارِدٌ وَالنُّورُ جَمِيلٌ.
lines.english: The morning is the most beautiful time. The air is cool and the light is beautiful.
lines.transliteration: As-sabahu huwa ajmalu waqt. Al-hawaa' baaridun wan-nuuru jamiil.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَيِّدٌ. لِنَرَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَفْهَمُ الوَقْتَ كَمَا نَفْهَمُهُ نَحْنُ.
lines.english: Good. Let's see if you understand time as we understand it.
lines.transliteration: Jayyid. Li-nara in kunta tafhamu al-waqta kama nafhamuhu nahnu.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدْتَ إِلَيْنَا. الصَّحْرَاءُ تُعَلِّمُنَا أَنَّ الوَقْتَ ثَمِينٌ.
lines.english: You have returned to us. The desert teaches us that time is precious.
lines.transliteration: 'Udta ilayna. As-sahraa'u tu'allimuna anna al-waqta thamiinun.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المَسَاءُ هُوَ وَقْتُ الرَّاحَةِ وَالحِكَايَاتِ عِنْدَ النَّارِ.
lines.english: The evening is the time of rest and stories by the fire.
lines.transliteration: Al-masaa'u huwa waqtu ar-raahah wal-hikaayaat 'inda an-naar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اليَوْمَ نَحْنُ هُنَا. هَذَا هُوَ اليَوْمُ — الآنَ، هَذِهِ اللَّحْظَةَ.
lines.english: Today we are here. This is today -- now, this moment.
lines.transliteration: Al-yawma nahnu huna. Hadha huwa al-yawm -- al-aan, hadhihi al-lahdhah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: غَدًا سَنَرْحَلُ مَعَ الرِّيحِ. غَدًا دَائِمًا يَأْتِي.
lines.english: Tomorrow we will travel with the wind. Tomorrow always comes.
lines.transliteration: Ghadan sanarhalu ma'a ar-riih. Ghadan daa'iman ya'ti.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَمْسِ مَضَى وَلَنْ يَعُودَ. لَا تَنْدَمْ عَلَى أَمْسِ.
lines.english: Yesterday has passed and will not return. Do not regret yesterday.
lines.transliteration: Amsi mada wa lan ya'uud. La tandam 'ala amsi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَلْ تَعْرِفُ الفَرْقَ بَيْنَ اليَوْمِ وَغَدٍ وَأَمْسِ؟ لِنَرَ!
lines.english: Do you know the difference between today, tomorrow, and yesterday? Let's see!
lines.transliteration: Hal ta'rifu al-farqa bayna al-yawmi wa ghadin wa amsi? Li-nara!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا! جِئْتَ فِي الوَقْتِ المُنَاسِبِ. عِنْدِي كَلِمَاتٌ جَدِيدَةٌ.
lines.english: Welcome! You came at the right time. I have new words.
lines.transliteration: Ahlan! Ji'ta fi al-waqti al-munaasib. 'Indi kalimaatun jadiidah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّاعَةُ تَقِيسُ الوَقْتَ. كَمْ سَاعَةً مَشَيْتَ فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ؟
lines.english: The hour measures time. How many hours did you walk in the desert?
lines.transliteration: As-saa'atu taqiisu al-waqt. Kam saa'atan mashayta fi as-sahraa'?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأُسْبُوعُ فِيهِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ. نَرْحَلُ كُلَّ أُسْبُوعٍ.
lines.english: The week has seven days. We travel every week.
lines.transliteration: Al-usbuu'u fiihi sab'atu ayyaam. Narhalu kulla usbuu'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الشَّهْرُ يَبْدَأُ مَعَ القَمَرِ الجَدِيدِ. نَحْنُ نَتْبَعُ القَمَرَ.
lines.english: The month begins with the new moon. We follow the moon.
lines.transliteration: Ash-shahru yabda'u ma'a al-qamari al-jadiid. Nahnu natba'u al-qamar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِخْتِبَارٌ أَخِيرٌ عَنِ الوَقْتِ. أَنْتَ جَاهِزٌ!
lines.english: A final test about time. You are ready!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم يا شاب. الحِكْمَةُ مَعَ التَّجْرِبَة
lines.english: Peace be upon you, young one. Wisdom comes with experience.
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu alaykum ya shaab. al-hikma ma'a at-tajriba

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The desert is a harsh teacher, but a fair one.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تُعَلِّمُنَا الصَّبْرَ وَقِيمَةَ المَاءِ وَقِيمَةَ الوَقْتِ.
lines.english: It teaches us patience, the value of water, and the value of time.
lines.transliteration: Tu'allimuna as-sabra wa qiimata al-maa'i wa qiimata al-waqt.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِحْفَظْ هَذَا فِي قَلْبِكَ يَا صَدِيقِي.
lines.english: Keep this in your heart, my friend.
lines.transliteration: Ihfadh hadha fi qalbika ya sadiiqi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: This village is very ancient.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I have seen ninety years here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And my grandfather was here before me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Wisdom does not come easily.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِذْهَب وَتَعَلَّم مِن كُلِّ أَهْل القَرْيَة
lines.english: Go and learn from all the village people.
lines.transliteration: idh-hab wa ta'allam min kull ahl al-qarya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Arabic proverbs are the wisdom of ancestors.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Proverb: Knowledge is light.

personality.catchphrase: الحِكْمَةُ مَعَ التَّجْرِبَة — al-hikma ma'a at-tajriba (Wisdom with experience)

greeting.english: Welcome! Come and hear a story!
greeting.transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan! Ta'aal wasma' qissah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا! أَنَا نُورٌ، الرَّاوِيَةُ. أَرْوِي القِصَصَ لِأَهْلِ المُخَيَّمِ.
lines.english: Hello! I am Noor, the storyteller. I tell stories for the people of the camp.
lines.transliteration: Ahlan! Ana Nuur, ar-raawiyah. Arwi al-qisas li-ahli al-mukhayyam.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي قِصَصِي حَيَوَانَاتٌ كَبِيرَةٌ وَصَغِيرَةٌ. لِنَبْدَأْ!
lines.english: In my stories there are big and small animals. Let's begin!
lines.transliteration: Fi qisasi hayawaanaatun kabiiratun wa saghiiratun. Li-nabda'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَانَ هُنَاكَ أَسَدٌ كَبِيرٌ يَعِيشُ فِي الجَبَلِ. كَبِيرٌ يَعْنِي... ضَخْمٌ!
lines.english: There was a big lion living in the mountain. Big means... huge!
lines.transliteration: Kaana hunaaka asadun kabiirun ya'iishu fi al-jabal. Kabiirun ya'ni... dakhm!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَكَانَتْ هُنَاكَ نَمْلَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ لَكِنَّهَا ذَكِيَّةٌ جِدًّا!
lines.english: And there was a small ant, but she was very smart!
lines.transliteration: Wa kaanat hunaaka namlatun saghiiratun laakinnaha dhakiyyatun jiddan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَسَدُ كَانَ قَوِيًّا. لَكِنَّ القُوَّةَ لَيْسَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ!
lines.english: The lion was strong. But strength is not everything!
lines.transliteration: Al-asadu kaana qawiyyan. Laakinna al-quwwata laysat kulla shay'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَلْ أَعْجَبَتْكَ القِصَّةُ؟ لِنَرَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَذْكُرُ الكَلِمَاتِ!
lines.english: Did you like the story? Let's see if you remember the words!
lines.transliteration: Hal a'jabatka al-qissah? Li-nara in kunta tadhkuru al-kalimaat!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدْتَ لِسَمَاعِ المَزِيدِ! عِنْدِي قِصَّةٌ أُخْرَى.
lines.english: You came back for more! I have another story.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَانَ هُنَاكَ أَرْنَبٌ سَرِيعٌ وَسُلَحْفَاةٌ بَطِيئَةٌ.
lines.english: There was a fast rabbit and a slow turtle.
lines.transliteration: Kaana hunaaka arnabun sarii'un wa sulahfaatun batii'ah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Fast! The rabbit runs like the wind!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: بَطِيءٌ! السُّلَحْفَاةُ تَمْشِي بِبُطْءٍ، لَكِنَّهَا لَا تَتَوَقَّفُ.
lines.english: Slow! The turtle walks slowly, but she never stops.
lines.transliteration: Batii'! As-sulahfaatu tamshi bi-but', laakinnaha la tatawwaqaf.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي النِّهَايَةِ، السُّلَحْفَاةُ فَازَتْ! كَانَتْ سَعِيدَةً جِدًّا!
lines.english: In the end, the turtle won! She was very happy!
lines.transliteration: Fi an-nihaayah, as-sulahfaatu faazat! Kaanat sa'iidatan jiddan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And the rabbit was sad because he lost.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A beautiful story! Do you remember the words?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hello! I have one last story for you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ، النَّهَارُ حَارٌّ جِدًّا كَالنَّارِ.
lines.english: In the desert, the daytime is very hot like fire.
lines.transliteration: Fi as-sahraa', an-nahaaru haarrun jiddan kan-naar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَاللَّيْلُ بَارِدٌ كَالمَاءِ. هَكَذَا هِيَ الصَّحْرَاءُ.
lines.english: And the night is cold like water. That is how the desert is.
lines.transliteration: Wal-laylu baaridun kal-maa'. Haakadha hiya as-sahraa'u.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: بَعْضُ القِصَصِ سَهْلَةٌ وَبَعْضُهَا صَعْبَةٌ. لَكِنَّ كُلَّهَا جَمِيلَةٌ!
lines.english: Some stories are easy and some are difficult. But all of them are beautiful!
lines.transliteration: Ba'du al-qisas sahlatun wa ba'duha sa'bah. Laakinna kullaha jamiilah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَهْلٌ. هَذِهِ الكَلِمَةُ سَهْلَةٌ، أَلَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ؟
lines.english: Easy. This word is easy, isn't it?
lines.transliteration: Sahlun. Hadhihi al-kalimatu sahlatun, alaysa kadhaalik?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: صَعْبٌ. لَا تَقْلَقْ، مَعَ التَّدْرِيبِ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ يَصِيرُ سَهْلًا!
lines.english: Difficult. Don't worry, with practice everything becomes easy!
lines.transliteration: Sa'bun. La taqlaq, ma'a at-tadriib kullu shay'in yasiiru sahlan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: This is the final test! You are ready!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً! يُحْكى أَنَّ اليَوْمَ يَوْمٌ جَميل لِلقِصَص
lines.english: Welcome! It is said that today is a beautiful day for stories.
lines.transliteration: ahlan! yuhkaa anna al-yawm yawmun jamiil lil-qisas

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَرْوِيَ القِصَصَ! وَعِنْدَنا نُصوصٌ لِلقِراءَة أَيْضًا
lines.english: I love telling stories! And we have reading passages too.
lines.transliteration: uḥibbu an arwiya al-qiṣaṣ! wa-ʿindanā nuṣūṣ li-l-qirāʾa ayḍan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القِراءَةُ تُساعِدُكَ على تَعَلُّمِ كَيْفَ تَتَرابَطُ الكَلِمات
lines.english: Reading helps you learn how words connect together.
lines.transliteration: al-qirāʾa tusāʿiduka ʿalā taʿallum kayfa tatarābaṭ al-kalimāt

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَرِّبْ تَمارينَ القِراءَة مِن قائِمَةِ 'أَنْشِطَة' في قائِمَةِ الإيقاف
lines.english: Try the reading exercises from 'Activities' in the pause menu.
lines.transliteration: jarrib tamārīn al-qirāʾa min qāʾimat 'anshiṭa' fī qāʾimat al-īqāf

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يُحْكى أَنَّ هُناكَ كَنْز قَديم مَدْفون في الصَّحْراء
lines.english: It is said that there is an ancient treasure buried in the desert.
lines.transliteration: yuhkaa anna hunaaka kanz qadiim madfuun fis-sahraa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: البَعْضُ يَقولُ إِنَّهُ ذَهَب، وَالبَعْضُ يَقولُ كُتُب
lines.english: Some say it's gold, and some say books.
lines.transliteration: al-ba'd yaquulu innahu dhahab, wal-ba'd yaquulu kutub

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: But no one has found it yet.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Descriptive words make stories beautiful.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Kabiir — big, saghiir — small.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمِعْتُ قِصَّة عَن تاجِر مِن بِلاد بَعيدَة
lines.english: I heard a story about a trader from faraway lands.
lines.transliteration: sami'tu qissa an taajir min bilaad ba'iida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَقولُ إِنَّ هُناكَ مُدُن مِن ذَهَب!
lines.english: He says there are cities of gold!
lines.transliteration: yaquulu inna hunaaka mudun min dhahab!

personality.catchphrase: يُحْكى أَنَّ — yuhkaa anna (It is said that...)

greeting.arabic: يَا سَلَامْ! مُسَافِرٌ آخَرُ! أَهْلًا بِكَ!
greeting.english: Oh wow! Another traveler! Welcome!
greeting.transliteration: Ya salaam! Musaafirun aakhar! Ahlan bik!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! أَنَا عَلِيٌّ الرَّحَّالَةُ! سَافَرْتُ مِنَ المَشْرِقِ إِلَى المَغْرِبِ!
lines.english: Welcome! I am Ali the Wanderer! I have traveled from east to west!
lines.transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan! Ana 'Aliyyun ar-rahaalah! Saafartu min al-mashriqi ila al-maghrib!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي السَّفَرِ تَحْتَاجُ أَنْ تَعْرِفَ أَفْعَالًا مُهِمَّةً. سَأُعَلِّمُكَ!
lines.english: In travel you need to know important verbs. I will teach you!
lines.transliteration: Fi as-safar tahtaaju an ta'rifa af'aalan muhimmah. Sa-u'allimuk!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ذَهَبَ. ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى كُلِّ مَكَانٍ! ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الجِبَالِ وَالبِحَارِ.
lines.english: To go. I went to every place! I went to the mountains and the seas.
lines.transliteration: Dhahaba. Dhahabtu ila kulli makaan! Dhahabtu ila al-jibaal wal-bihaar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَاءَ. وَدَائِمًا أَجِيءُ إِلَى هَذَا المُخَيَّمِ، فَهُوَ بَيْتِي!
lines.english: To come. And I always come to this camp, for it is my home!
lines.transliteration: Jaa'a. Wa daa'iman ajii'u ila hadha al-mukhayyam, fa-huwa bayti!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَشَى. مَشَيْتُ أَيَّامًا فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ تَحْتَ الشَّمْسِ الحَارَّةِ!
lines.english: To walk. I walked for days in the desert under the hot sun!
lines.transliteration: Masha. Mashaytu ayyaaman fi as-sahraa' tahta ash-shamsi al-haarrah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Three verbs for travel! Let's test you!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جِئْتَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى! مُمْتَازٌ! فِي السَّفَرِ تَحْتَاجُ حَوَاسَّكَ.
lines.english: You came again! Excellent! In travel you need your senses.
lines.transliteration: Ji'ta marratan ukhra! Mumtaaz! Fi as-safar tahtaaju hawaassak.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رَأَى. رَأَيْتُ أَشْيَاءَ عَجِيبَةً فِي رِحْلَاتِي! وَاحَاتٌ وَسَطَ الرِّمَالِ!
lines.english: To see. I saw amazing things on my journeys! Oases in the middle of the sand!
lines.transliteration: Ra'a. Ra'aytu ashyaa'a 'ajiibatan fi rihlaati! Waahaat wasata ar-rimaal!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمِعَ. سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ الذِّئْبِ فِي اللَّيْلِ. كَانَ مُخِيفًا!
lines.english: To hear. I heard the sound of the wolf at night. It was scary!
lines.transliteration: Sami'a. Sami'tu sawta adh-dhi'bi fi al-layl. Kaana mukhiifan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَكَلَّمَ. تَكَلَّمْتُ مَعَ نَاسٍ كَثِيرِينَ بِلُغَاتٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ!
lines.english: To speak. I spoke with many people in different languages!
lines.transliteration: Takallama. Takallamtu ma'a naasin kathiiriin bi-lughaat mukhtalifah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فَهِمَ. أَهَمُّ شَيْءٍ هُوَ أَنْ تَفْهَمَ النَّاسَ!
lines.english: To understand. The most important thing is to understand people!
lines.transliteration: Fahima. Ahammu shay'in huwa an tafhama an-naas!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَرْبَعَةُ أَفْعَالٍ جَدِيدَةٍ! لِنَرَ كَمْ تَذْكُرُ!
lines.english: Four new verbs! Let's see how much you remember!
lines.transliteration: Arba'atu af'aalin jadiidah! Li-nara kam tadhkur!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَا صَدِيقِي! اليَوْمَ سَأُعَلِّمُكَ عِبَارَاتٍ مُفِيدَةً لِلسَّفَرِ.
lines.english: My friend! Today I will teach you useful phrases for travel.
lines.transliteration: Ya sadiiqi! Al-yawma sa-u'allimuka 'ibaaraatin mufiidah lis-safar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِنْدَمَا تَفْهَمُ شَخْصًا، قُلْ: أَنَا أَفْهَمُ! هَذَا يُفْرِحُ النَّاسَ.
lines.english: When you understand someone, say: I understand! This makes people happy.
lines.transliteration: 'Indama tafhamu shakhsan, qul: Ana afhamu! Hadha yufrihu an-naas.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَفْهَمْ، لَا تَخْجَلْ! قُلْ: لَا أَفْهَمُ.
lines.english: And if you don't understand, don't be shy! Say: I don't understand.
lines.transliteration: Wa idha lam tafham, la takhajal! Qul: La afhamu.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَأَهَمُّ عِبَارَةٍ: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ مُسَاعَدَتِي؟ هَذِهِ أَنْقَذَتْنِي مَرَّاتٍ كَثِيرَةً!
lines.english: And the most important phrase: Can you help me? This saved me many times!
lines.transliteration: Wa ahammu 'ibaarah: Hal yumkinuka musaa'adati? Hadhihi anqadhatni marraat kathiirah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ العِبَارَاتُ سَتُسَاعِدُكَ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ! اِخْتِبَارٌ أَخِيرٌ!
lines.english: These phrases will help you everywhere! One last test!
lines.transliteration: Hadhihi al-'ibaaaraat satusaa'iduka fi kulli makaan! Ikhtibaarun akhiir!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hey there! The journey is always an adventure.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The desert is full of secrets.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I have seen places no one knows.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: واحات مَخْفِيَّة، كُهوف قَديمَة، آثار ضائِعَة
lines.english: Hidden oases, ancient caves, lost ruins.
lines.transliteration: waahaat makhfiyya, kuhuuf qadiima, aathaar daa'i'a

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I have traveled to many lands.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: In the north, the mountains are covered with snow.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَفي الجَنوب، البِحارُ لا نِهايَة لَها
lines.english: And in the south, the seas have no end.
lines.transliteration: wa fil-januub, al-bihaar laa nihaaya lahaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I need a partner for an exploration journey.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Are you brave enough?

personality.catchphrase: الرِّحْلَةُ مُغامَرَة — ar-rihla mughaamara (The journey is an adventure)

greeting.english: Welcome, traveler. The mountain awaits you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I am Salim, guide of this mountain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِشتُ هُنا سِنين طَويلَة. أَعرِفُ كُلَّ حَيَوان
lines.english: I have lived here many years. I know every animal.
lines.transliteration: ishtu hunaa siniin tawiila. a'rifu kulla hayawaan

choices.english: I want to know the place first

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اُنظُر إِلى السَّماء. هَل تَرى ذَلِك الطَّيْر الكَبير؟
lines.english: Look at the sky. Do you see that big bird?
lines.transliteration: unzur ila as-samaa'. hal taraa dhaalik at-tayr al-kabiir?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: That is an eagle — king of the birds.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Be careful! Among the rocks lives the snake.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَهُناكَ أَرْنَبٌ — سَريعٌ جِدّاً في القَفْز
lines.english: And there is a rabbit — very fast at jumping.
lines.transliteration: wa hunaaka arnabun — sarii'un jiddan fil-qafz

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Three animals. Did you memorize them?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدتَ. جَيِّد. الجَبَل فيهِ حَيَوانات أَكثَر
lines.english: You returned. Good. The mountain has more animals.
lines.transliteration: udta. jayyid. al-jabal fiihi hayawaanaat akthar

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The lion — the strongest animal in the mountain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The ant — small but strong.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القِطَّةٌ — تَعيشُ مَعَ النّاس في القَرْيَة
lines.english: The cat — lives with the people in the village.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The dog — guards the houses.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Four new animals. Test yourself.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحَيَوانات لَها صِفات. لِنَتَعَلَّم بَعْض الصِّفات
lines.english: Animals have qualities. Let's learn some adjectives.
lines.transliteration: al-hayawaanaat lahaa sifaat. linata'allam ba'd as-sifaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَدِيدٌ — مِثل الثَّلج الجَديد عَلى الجَبَل
lines.english: New — like the new snow on the mountain.
lines.transliteration: jadiidun — mithl ath-thalj al-jadiid ala al-jabal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Old — like these old rocks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَمِيلٌ — مِثل مَنظَر الجَبَل عِندَ الغُروب
lines.english: Beautiful — like the mountain view at sunset.
lines.transliteration: jamiilun — mithl manzar al-jabal inda al-ghuruub

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَلِمات مُهِمَّة. هَيّا نَرى ماذا تَذكُر
lines.english: Important words. Let's see what you remember.
lines.transliteration: kalimaat muhimma. hayyaa naraa maadha tadhkur

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ قَرْيَة الجَبَل. مَكان هادِئ وَجَميل
lines.english: This is the mountain village. A quiet and beautiful place.
lines.transliteration: haadhihi qaryat al-jabal. makaan haadi' wa jamiil

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Zahra the weaver makes the finest clothes.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And Khadija the healer knows all the herbs.
lines.transliteration: wa khadiija al-mu'aalija ta'rifu kulla al-a'shaab

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome! I am Salim, your guide. Follow me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Directions are important! Let me teach you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Yamiin — right, yasaar — left.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Amaam — front, khalf — behind.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: There are eight zones in the world.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The oasis, the library, the market, the Bedouin camp, and more.

choices.english: I want to visit them all

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I need an assistant to map the area.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Visit all the zones and return to me.
lines.transliteration: zur kull al-manaatiq wa ud ilayya

personality.catchphrase: اِتَّبِعْني — ittabi'nii (Follow me)

greeting.english: Welcome! Come see my work.
greeting.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! ta'aal shuuf a'maalii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hello! I am Zahra the weaver.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحيكُ الثِّياب مُنذُ كُنتُ صَغيرَة. كُلّ قِطعَة لَها اسم
lines.english: I've been weaving clothes since I was little. Every piece has a name.
lines.transliteration: ahiiku ath-thiyaab mundhu kuntu saghiira. kullu qit'a lahaa ism

choices.english: Teach me the names of clothes

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لِنَبدَأ بِالأَساسِيّات. هَذا ثَوْب — لِباس تَقليدِيّ
lines.english: Let's start with the basics. This is a thobe — a traditional garment.
lines.transliteration: linabda' bil-asaasiyyaat. haadha thawb — libaas taqlidiiy

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And this is a dress — a beautiful garment for women.
lines.transliteration: wa haadha fustaan — libaas jamiil lin-nisaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And a shirt — worn by men and women.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ثَلاث قِطَع مِن الثِّياب. هَل تَذكُرها؟
lines.english: Three pieces of clothing. Do you remember them?
lines.transliteration: thalaath qita' min ath-thiyaab. hal tadhkuruhaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You're back! I have more pieces to show you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Pants — for the lower half.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A scarf — covers the head and neck.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Shoes — for walking on the mountain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A hat — protects from the sun.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Four new pieces! Let's see how you do.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ الله! أَنتَ تَتَعَلَّم بِسُرعَة
lines.english: Mashallah! You learn quickly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A belt — ties the clothes around the waist.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A bag — for carrying things.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: خَاتَم — حِليَة لِلإِصبَع. أَصنَعُها مِن الفِضَّة
lines.english: A ring — jewelry for the finger. I make them from silver.
lines.transliteration: khaatam — hilya lil-isba'. asna'uhaa min al-fidda

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The last three words! Let's test.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: شُكراً! أُمّي عَلَّمَتني الحِياكَة وَأَنا صَغيرَة
lines.english: Thank you! My mother taught me weaving when I was young.
lines.transliteration: shukran! ummii allamatnii al-hiyaaka wa ana saghiira

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلّ خَيط لَهُ لَون وَمَعنى. تَعال أُعَلِّمك الأَسماء
lines.english: Every thread has a color and meaning. Come, I'll teach you the names.
lines.transliteration: kullu khayt lahuu lawn wa ma'naa. ta'aal u'allimak al-asmaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome. Beauty is in the details.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: What do you want?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Clothing is art. Let me teach you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Thawb — dress, qamiis — shirt.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Arabic weaving is an ancient tradition.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: We use natural colors from plants.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The new fashion in the market: blue!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Everyone wants blue fabrics.

personality.catchphrase: الجَمالُ في التَّفاصيل — al-jamaal fit-tafaasiil (Beauty is in the details)

greeting.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم يا بُنَيّ. كَيفَ حالُك؟
greeting.english: Peace be upon you, dear child. How are you?
greeting.transliteration: as-salaamu alaykum ya bunayy. kayfa haaluk?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا خَديجَة. أُعالِجُ النّاس بِالأَعشاب مُنذُ سَنَوات طَويلَة
lines.english: I am Khadija. I have been treating people with herbs for many long years.
lines.transliteration: ana khadiija. u'aaliju an-naas bil-a'shaab mundhu sanawaat tawiila

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لِكَي تَفهَم الطِّبّ، يَجِب أَن تَعرِف الصِّفات
lines.english: To understand medicine, you must know adjectives.
lines.transliteration: likay tafham at-tibb, yajib an ta'rif as-sifaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِندَما يَأتي مَريض، أَسأَلُهُ عَن حالِه. لِنَبدَأ
lines.english: When a patient comes, I ask about their condition. Let's begin.
lines.transliteration: indamaa ya'tii mariid, as'aluhu an haalihi. linabda'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَظِيفٌ — الجُرح يَجِب أَن يَكون نَظيفاً
lines.english: Clean — the wound must be clean.
lines.transliteration: naziifun — al-jurh yajib an yakuuna naziifan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَسِخٌ — إِذا كانَ وَسِخاً، يُصبِح أَسوَأ
lines.english: Dirty — if it is dirty, it gets worse.
lines.transliteration: wasikhun — idhaa kaana wasikhan, yusbihu aswa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Strong — a strong body heals quickly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Good. Did you understand these adjectives?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً يا بُنَيّ. لِنُكمِل دَرسَنا في الصِّفات
lines.english: Welcome, dear child. Let's continue our lesson in adjectives.
lines.transliteration: ahlan ya bunayy. linukmil darsanaa fis-sifaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ضَعِيفٌ — عَكس قَوِيّ. المَريض يَكون ضَعيفاً
lines.english: Weak — the opposite of strong. The sick person is weak.
lines.transliteration: da'iifun — aks qawiyy. al-mariid yakuun da'iifan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: طَوِيلٌ — الشَّجَرَة طَويلَة فيها أَعشاب مُفيدَة
lines.english: Tall/Long — the tall tree has useful herbs.
lines.transliteration: tawiilun — ash-shajara tawiila fiihaa a'shaab mufiida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَصِيرٌ — الأَعشاب القَصيرَة قَريبَة مِن الأَرض
lines.english: Short — the short herbs are close to the ground.
lines.transliteration: qasiirun — al-a'shaab al-qasiira qariiba min al-ard

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَبِيحٌ — بَعض الأَدوِيَة طَعمُها قَبيح لَكِنَّها مُفيدَة
lines.english: Ugly/Unpleasant — some medicines taste bad but they are useful.
lines.transliteration: qabiihun — ba'd al-adwiya ta'muhaa qabiih laakinnaha mufiida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَربَع صِفات جَديدَة. لِنَرى ماذا تَذكُر
lines.english: Four new adjectives. Let's see what you remember.
lines.transliteration: arba' sifaat jadiida. linaraa maadha tadhkur

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنتَ تَتَقَدَّم. اليَوم نَتَعَلَّم شَيئاً مُختَلِفاً
lines.english: You are progressing. Today we learn something different.
lines.transliteration: anta tataqaddam. al-yawm nata'allam shay'an mukhtalifan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Socks — protect the feet from the cold.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Glasses — help weak eyes.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Happy — a happy person heals faster.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مُمتاز! هَيّا نَختَبِر كُلّ ما تَعَلَّمتَ
lines.english: Excellent! Let's test everything you learned.
lines.transliteration: mumtaaz! hayyaa nakhtabir kulla maa ta'allamta

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَعشاب هِيَ دَواء الطَّبيعَة. كُلّ عُشبَة لَها فائِدَة
lines.english: Herbs are nature's medicine. Every herb has a benefit.
lines.transliteration: al-a'shaab hiya dawaa' at-tabii'a. kullu ushba lahaa faa'ida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَكِن أَوَّلاً يَجِب أَن تَعرِف الصِّفات لِتَصِف الأَعراض
lines.english: But first you must know adjectives to describe symptoms.
lines.transliteration: laakin awwalan yajib an ta'rif as-sifaat litasif al-a'raad

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً يا بُنَيّ. بِالشِّفاء إِن شاء الله
lines.english: Hello, dear child. May healing come, God willing.
lines.transliteration: ahlan ya bunayy. bish-shifaa' in shaa' allaah

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The body is a trust. Let us learn its parts.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Head — it carries the mind.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hand — with it we touch and heal.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Eye — it sees medicine and illness.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Well done! You learned three words.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Arab medicine is very ancient.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَجدادُنا اِستَخدَموا النَّعناع لِلمَعِدَة وَالبابونَج لِلنَّوم
lines.english: Our ancestors used mint for the stomach and chamomile for sleep.
lines.transliteration: ajdaadunaa istakhdamuu an-na'naa' lil-ma'ida wal-baabunaj lin-nawm

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلُّ عُشبَة فيها حِكمَة مِن الله
lines.english: Every herb contains wisdom from God.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَأَنا أُحاوِل أَن أُعَلِّم هَذِهِ الحِكمَة لِلجيل الجَديد
lines.english: And I try to teach this wisdom to the new generation.
lines.transliteration: wa ana uhaawilu an u'allima haadhihi al-hikma lil-jiil al-jadiid

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل سَمِعت؟ الحَدّاد داوود يَشكو مِن ظَهرِه
lines.english: Have you heard? Blacksmith Daud complains about his back.
lines.transliteration: hal sami't? al-haddaad daawuud yashkuu min zahrihi

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قُلتُ لَهُ: اِشرَب شاي الزَّنجَبيل كُلّ صَباح
lines.english: I told him: drink ginger tea every morning.
lines.transliteration: qultu lahu: ishrab shaay az-zanjabiil kulla sabaah

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالأَميرَة عائِشَة طَلَبَت مِنّي أَعشاباً لِلنَّوم
lines.english: And Princess Aisha asked me for herbs for sleep.

personality.catchphrase: بِالشِّفاء إِن شاء الله — bish-shifaa' in shaa' allaah (May you be healed, God willing)

greeting.arabic: أَهْلاً يا بَحّار! هَل أَنتَ مُستَعِدّ لِلبَحر؟
greeting.english: Welcome, sailor! Are you ready for the sea?
greeting.transliteration: ahlan ya bahhaar! hal anta musta'idd lil-bahr?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا القُبطان رَشيد! أُبحِرُ في هَذا البَحر مُنذُ عِشرين سَنَة
lines.english: I am Captain Rashid! I've sailed this sea for twenty years.
lines.transliteration: ana al-qubtaan rashiid! ubhiru fii haadha al-bahr mundhu ishriina sana

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: البَحّار الحَقيقِيّ يَعرِف الاِتِّجاهات. بِدون ذَلِك تَضيع
lines.english: A true sailor knows directions. Without that, you get lost.
lines.transliteration: al-bahhaar al-haqiiqiyy ya'rif al-ittijaahaat. biduun dhaalik tadii'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Listen well! These are the most important directions.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: North — where the North Star points.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَنُوب — عَكس الشَّمال، حَيثُ المِياه الدّافِئَة
lines.english: South — opposite of north, where the warm waters are.
lines.transliteration: januub — aks ash-shamaal, haythu al-miyaah ad-daafi'a

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: East — where the sun rises.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ثَلاث اِتِّجاهات. هَل تَستَطيع أَن تَتَذَكَّرها؟
lines.english: Three directions. Can you remember them?
lines.transliteration: thalaath ittijaahaat. hal tastatii' an tatadhaakkarahaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You're back, sailor! Let's complete our map.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: West — where the sun sets.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Right — turn the rudder right!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Left — turn the rudder left!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Up/Above — look up at the sail.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Four words! Test yourself.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ الله! أَنتَ مَلّاح مُمتاز
lines.english: Mashallah! You are an excellent navigator.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Below/Under — the treasure is under the water.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَرِيب — الميناء قَريب! أَستَطيع أَن أَراه
lines.english: Near — the port is near! I can see it.
lines.transliteration: qariib — al-miinaa' qariib! astatii' an araahu

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Far — the island is far, we need two days.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الآن تَعرِف كُلّ الاِتِّجاهات! اِختِبار أَخير
lines.english: Now you know all the directions! One final test.
lines.transliteration: al-aan ta'rif kull al-ittijaahaat! ikhtibaar akhiir

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: البَحر مِثل الحَياة — أَحياناً هادِئ وَأَحياناً عاصِف
lines.english: The sea is like life — sometimes calm and sometimes stormy.
lines.transliteration: al-bahr mithl al-hayaah — ahyaanan haadi' wa ahyaanan aasif

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَنا في الميناء تَجِد سَمَكاً طازَجاً عِند هَنا
lines.english: Here at the port you'll find fresh fish at Hana's stall.
lines.transliteration: hunaa fil-miinaa' tajid samakan taazajan inda hanaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And Daud the blacksmith makes the best anchors.
lines.transliteration: wa daawuud al-haddaad yasna' afdal al-maraasii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ماذا تُريد؟ يا لَلبَحر، الوَقتُ ضَيِّق
lines.english: What do you want? By the sea, time is short.
lines.transliteration: maadha turiid? ya lal-bahr, al-waqtu dayyiq

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A sailor needs to know directions.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: North — toward the pole star.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Right — the starboard side of the ship.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Left — the port side.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The Arabs were masters of the seas.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِبنُ ماجِد كانَ أَعظَم مَلّاح عَرَبي
lines.english: Ibn Majid was the greatest Arab navigator.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هُوَ الَّذي أَرشَدَ فاسكو دي غاما إِلى الهِند
lines.english: He is the one who guided Vasco da Gama to India.
lines.transliteration: huwa alladhii arshada faaskuu dii ghaamaa ilaa al-hind

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: There is a shipment lost near the harbor.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I need someone who knows directions to find it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A new ship arrived from Morocco.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَنادِيَة رَئيسَة المِيناء تَشكو مِن التُّجّار
lines.english: And Nadia the dockmaster complains about the merchants.
lines.transliteration: wa naadiya ra'iisat al-miinaa' tashkuu min at-tujjaar

personality.catchphrase: يا لَلبَحر! — ya lal-bahr! (Oh, the sea!)

greeting.arabic: يا هَلا يا هَلا! سَمَك طازَج! تَعال تَعال!
greeting.english: Welcome welcome! Fresh fish! Come come!
greeting.transliteration: ya halaa ya halaa! samak taazaj! ta'aal ta'aal!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً! أَنا هَنا، أَبيع أَطيَب سَمَك في الميناء!
lines.english: Hello! I'm Hana, I sell the tastiest fish in the port!
lines.transliteration: ahlan! ana hanaa, abii' atyab samak fil-miinaa'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِندي سَمَك وَمَشروبات. هَل تُريد أَن تَعرِف أَسماءَها؟
lines.english: I have fish and drinks. Do you want to know their names?
lines.transliteration: indii samak wa mashruubaat. hal turiid an ta'rif asmaa'ahaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَلّا بِسم الله! أَوَّل شَيء — سَمَكٌ!
lines.english: Let's go, bismillah! First thing — fish!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمَكٌ — طازَج مِن البَحر هَذا الصَّباح!
lines.english: Fish — fresh from the sea this morning!
lines.transliteration: samakun — taazaj min al-bahr haadha as-sabaah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And after the fish, hot tea!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَو قَهْوَةٌ عَرَبِيَّة — أَحلى قَهوَة في المِنطَقَة!
lines.english: Or Arabic coffee — the best coffee in the area!
lines.transliteration: aw qahwatun arabiyya — ahlaa qahwa fil-mintaqa!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Three delicious words! Come on, quiz time!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رَجَعتَ! الحَمدُ لِلَّه. عِندي أَكل وَشُرب أَكثَر!
lines.english: You came back! Alhamdulillah. I have more food and drink!
lines.transliteration: raja'ta! al-hamdu lillaah. indii akl wa shurb akthar!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Soup — hot fish soup for the sailors.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Juice — fresh orange juice!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فَاكِهَةٌ — عِندي فَواكِه مِن كُلّ الأَنواع
lines.english: Fruit — I have fruits of all kinds.
lines.transliteration: faakihatun — indii fawaakiih min kull al-anwaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سُكَّرٌ — هَل تُريد سُكَّر في الشّاي؟
lines.english: Sugar — do you want sugar in your tea?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Four words! Let's see!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يا سَلام! أَحسَن زَبون عِندي! كَلِمات أَخيرَة
lines.english: Wonderful! My best customer! Last words.
lines.transliteration: yaa salaam! ahsan zabuun indii! kalimaat akhiira

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مِلْحٌ — السَّمَك بِدون مِلح ما لَهُ طَعم!
lines.english: Salt — fish without salt has no taste!
lines.transliteration: milhun — as-samak biduun milh maa lahuu ta'm!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: بَحْر — هَذا البَحر يُعطينا السَّمَك كُلّ يَوم
lines.english: Sea — this sea gives us fish every day.
lines.transliteration: bahr — haadha al-bahr yu'tiinaa as-samak kull yawm

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَهْر — المِياه العَذبَة تَأتي مِن النَّهر
lines.english: River — the fresh water comes from the river.
lines.transliteration: nahr — al-miyaah al-adhba ta'tii min an-nahr

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Final quiz! Bismillah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذا مَحَلّي! أَبيع هُنا كُلّ يَوم مِن الفَجر
lines.english: This is my stall! I sell here every day from dawn.
lines.transliteration: haadha mahallii! abii' hunaa kull yawm min al-fajr

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: البَحّارَة يَجلِبون السَّمَك وَأَنا أَبيعُه لِلنّاس
lines.english: The sailors bring the fish and I sell it to the people.
lines.transliteration: al-bahhaara yajlibuun as-samak wa ana abii'uhu lin-naas

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Come learn the names of food and drink!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Fresh! Fresh! Welcome, my dear!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Food is half of life! Come, let us learn.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Fish — this is what I sell.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Bread — every meal needs bread.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Water — without water there is no life.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: My father taught me fishing when I was little.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَخرُج مَع الفَجر وَنَعود مَع الشَّمس
lines.english: We go out at dawn and return with the sun.
lines.transliteration: nakhruj ma' al-fajr wa na'uud ma' ash-shams

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The tastiest fish is the morning fish.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القُبطان رَشيد زَعلان اليَوم — سَفينَة تَأَخَّرَت
lines.english: Captain Rashid is angry today — a ship was late.
lines.transliteration: al-qubtaan rashiid za'laan al-yawm — safiina ta'akhkharat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالتاجِر حَسَن يَبحَث عَن تَوابِل جَديدَة
lines.english: And Trader Hassan is looking for new spices.

personality.catchphrase: طازَج! طازَج! — taazaj! taazaj! (Fresh! Fresh!)

name: Blacksmith Daud
role: Teaches trade items and nature words

greeting.english: Welcome. The iron speaks with its voice. Listen.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا داوُد الحَدّاد. أَصنَعُ مِن الحَديد ما يَحتاجُه النّاس
lines.english: I am Daud the blacksmith. I craft from iron what people need.
lines.transliteration: ana daawuud al-haddaad. asna'u min al-hadiid maa yahtaajuhu an-naas

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Trade and nature — both teach patience.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Trade needs tools. Let's begin.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مِيزَان — أَصنَعُهُ بِيَدَيَّ. يَزِنُ الذَّهَب وَالفِضَّة
lines.english: Scale — I make it with my hands. It weighs gold and silver.
lines.transliteration: miizaan — asna'uhu biyadayya. yazinu adh-dhahab wal-fidda

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Dirham — the coin that merchants use.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Mountain — the iron comes from the mountain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Three words. Simple but important.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You returned. Good. A blacksmith observes nature.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رِيح — الرّيح تُشعِل النّار في الكِير
lines.english: Wind — the wind lights the fire in the furnace.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمَاء — أَنظُرُ إِلى السَّماء لِأَعرِف الطَّقس
lines.english: Sky — I look at the sky to know the weather.
lines.transliteration: samaa' — anzuru ila as-samaa' li-a'rif at-taqs

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَجْم — في اللَّيل، النُّجوم تُنير الطَّريق
lines.english: Star — at night, the stars light the path.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Nature is a great teacher. Do you remember?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنتَ صَبور مِثل الحَدّاد. هَذا جَيِّد
lines.english: You are patient like a blacksmith. That is good.
lines.transliteration: anta sabuur mithl al-haddaad. haadha jayyid

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَجَّادَة — التُّجّار يَبيعون سَجّاجيد مِن كُلّ مَكان
lines.english: Carpet — merchants sell carpets from everywhere.
lines.transliteration: sajjaada — at-tujjaar yabii'uun sajaajiid min kull makaan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Merchant — the one who buys and sells.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Spice — spices give food flavor.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A final test. Prove that you have learned.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَعمَل هُنا كُلّ يَوم مِن الفَجر إِلى المَغرِب
lines.english: I work here every day from dawn to dusk.
lines.transliteration: a'mal hunaa kull yawm min al-fajr ila al-maghrib

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحَديد يُعَلِّمُك الصَّبر. إِذا اِستَعجَلتَ، يَنكَسِر
lines.english: Iron teaches you patience. If you rush, it breaks.
lines.transliteration: al-hadiid yu'allimuk as-sabr. idha ista'jalta, yankasir

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَاللُّغَة مِثل الحَديد. تَحتاج وَقتاً وَصَبراً
lines.english: And language is like iron. It needs time and patience.
lines.transliteration: wal-lugha mithl al-hadiid. tahtaaj waqtan wa sabran

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Iron does not lie. What do you want?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Tools are the blacksmith's language.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَحْم — المَعدِن يُشبِه اللَّحم عِندَ الصَّهر
lines.english: Meat — metal resembles meat when melting.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Above — place the hammer above the anvil.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Below — the fire below the metal.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: My father and grandfather were blacksmiths.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّيف العَرَبي — أَجمَل ما صَنَعَت يَدُ إِنسان
lines.english: The Arab sword — the most beautiful thing a hand ever made.
lines.transliteration: as-sayf al-'arabii — ajmal maa sana'at yadu insaan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Patience is the secret of good smithing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ظَهري يُؤلِمُني. خَديجَة أَعطَتني شاي زَنجَبيل
lines.english: My back hurts. Khadija gave me ginger tea.
lines.transliteration: zahrii yu'limunii. khadiija a'tatnii shaay zanjabiil

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القُبطان يُريد سَيفاً جَديداً. كَثير العَمَل
lines.english: The captain wants a new sword. Lots of work.
lines.transliteration: al-qubtaan yuriid sayfan jadiidan. kathiir al-'amal

personality.catchphrase: الحَديدُ لا يَكذِب — al-hadiidu laa yakdhib (Iron does not lie)

greeting.arabic: مَرْحَباً بِكَ فِي القَصْرِ المَلَكِيّ، يا ضَيْفَنا الكَرِيم
greeting.english: Welcome to the Royal Palace, our honored guest
greeting.transliteration: marhaban bika fil-qasri al-malakiyy, ya dayfanaa al-kariim

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا الوَزِير عَبّاس، حارِسُ آدابِ البَلاط
lines.english: I am Vizier Abbas, keeper of court etiquette.
lines.transliteration: ana al-waziir abbaas, haarisu aadaab al-balaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَقَد وَصَلْتَ إِلى القَصْرِ المَلَكِيّ — نِهايَةُ رِحْلَتِكَ الطَّوِيلَة
lines.english: You have reached the Royal Palace — the end of your long journey.
lines.transliteration: laqad wasalta ilaa al-qasri al-malakiyy — nihaayatu rihlatika at-tawiila

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَكِنْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ، يَجِبُ أَنْ تَتَعَلَّمَ آدابَ القَصْر
lines.english: But before you enter, you must learn the manners of the palace.
lines.transliteration: laakin qabla an tadkhula, yajibu an tata'allama aadaab al-qasr

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي القَصْرِ، الأَدَبُ أَهَمُّ مِنَ القُوَّة. لِنَبْدَأ
lines.english: In the palace, manners are more important than strength. Let us begin.
lines.transliteration: fil-qasri, al-adabu ahammu min al-quwwa. linabda'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَوْ سَمَحْتَ — تَقُولُها عِنْدَما تَطْلُبُ شَيْئاً بِأَدَب
lines.english: Law samaht — you say it when you ask for something politely.
lines.transliteration: law samaht — taquuluhaa indamaa tatlub shay'an bi-adab

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ana aasif — you say it when you make a mistake.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Mabrook — you say it to congratulate someone.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: حَسَنٌ، لِنَرَ إِنْ حَفِظْتَ هَذِهِ العِبارات
lines.english: Good, let us see if you memorized these phrases.
lines.transliteration: hasanun, linara in hafizta haadhihi al-ibaaraat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عَوْدَةٌ مُبارَكَة! لَدَيَّ عِبارَاتٌ مُهِمَّة أُخرَى
lines.english: Blessed return! I have more important phrases for you.
lines.transliteration: awdatun mubaaraka! ladayya ibaaraatun muhimma ukhraa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لا أَعْرِفُ — تَقُولُها عِنْدَما لا تَعْرِفُ الجَوابَ
lines.english: La a'rif — you say it when you don't know the answer.
lines.transliteration: laa a'rif — taquuluhaa indamaa laa ta'rif al-jawaab

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا أَتَعَلَّمُ العَرَبِيَّةَ — عِبارَةٌ مُفِيدَة جِدّاً لِلضُّيُوف
