lines.english: Ana ata'allam al-arabiyya — a very useful phrase for guests.
lines.transliteration: ana ata'allamu al-arabiyya — ibaaratun mufiida jiddan lid-duyuuf

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما هَذا؟ — تَسْأَلُ بِها عَن الأَشْياء
lines.english: Ma haadha? — you ask it about things.
lines.transliteration: maa haadha? — tas'alu bihaa an al-ashyaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Haadha... — and the answer is like this.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Test yourself now!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنْتَ تَتَقَدَّمُ بِسُرْعَة. هَذِهِ العِباراتُ مِنْ أَعْمَقِ ما فِي لُغَتِنا
lines.english: You are progressing quickly. These phrases are among the deepest in our language.
lines.transliteration: anta tataqaddamu bisur'a. haadhihi al-ibaaraatu min a'maqi maa fii lughatinaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: إِنْ شاءَ اللَّهُ — نَقُولُها عِنْدَما نَتَكَلَّمُ عَنِ المُسْتَقْبَل
lines.english: In shaa' Allah — we say it when speaking about the future.
lines.transliteration: in shaa'allaah — naquuluhaa indamaa natakallamu an al-mustaqbal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ اللَّهُ — نَقُولُها عِنْدَ الإِعْجاب
lines.english: Ma shaa' Allah — we say it when we admire something.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ — نَقُولُها قَبْلَ كُلِّ عَمَل
lines.english: Bismillah — we say it before every action.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ كَلِماتٌ تَحْمِلُ بَرَكَة. هَل تَحْفَظُها؟
lines.english: These are words that carry blessing. Do you remember them?
lines.transliteration: haadhihi kalimaatun tahmilu baraka. hal tahfazuhaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذا القَصْرُ المَلَكِيّ بُنِيَ قَبْلَ مِئاتِ السِّنِين
lines.english: This Royal Palace was built hundreds of years ago.
lines.transliteration: haadha al-qasru al-malakiyy buniya qabla mi'aati as-siniin

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هُنا تَسْكُنُ الأَمِيرَةُ عائِشَة، وَالإِمامُ مُحَمَّد يُعَلِّمُ فِي المَكْتَبَة
lines.english: Here lives Princess Aisha, and Imam Muhammad teaches in the library.
lines.transliteration: hunaa taskunu al-amiiiratu aa'isha, wal-imaamu muhammad yu'allimu fil-maktaba

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالشّاعِرُ الرُّومِيّ يَزُورُنا كَثِيراً بِأَشْعارِهِ الجَمِيلَة
lines.english: And the poet Rumi visits us often with his beautiful poetry.
lines.transliteration: wash-shaa'iru ar-ruumiyy yazuurunaa kathiiran bi-ash'aarihi al-jamiila

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: By the king's command. Speak quickly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ المَملَكَة بُنِيَت عَلى العِلم وَالعَدل
lines.english: This kingdom was built on knowledge and justice.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المَلِكُ الأَوَّل أَسَّسَ المَكتَبَة قَبلَ القَصر
lines.english: The first king founded the library before the palace.
lines.transliteration: al-maliku al-awwal assasa al-maktaba qabla al-qasr

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: This says a lot about our values.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The kingdom needs those who serve it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: If you prove yourself, I will give you a mission.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَميرَة عائِشَة تُريد السَّفَر لَكِنَّ المَلِك يَرفُض
lines.english: Princess Aisha wants to travel but the king refuses.
lines.transliteration: al-amiira 'aa'isha turiid as-safar laakinna al-malik yarfud

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And the poet Rumi is writing a poem for the king.

personality.catchphrase: بِأَمرِ المَلِك — bi-amr al-malik (By the king's command)

greeting.arabic: أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً! يُسْعِدُنِي لِقاؤُكَ فِي قَصْرِنا
greeting.english: Welcome! I am delighted to meet you in our palace
greeting.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! yus'idunii liqaa'uka fii qasrinaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا الأَمِيرَةُ عائِشَة. سَمِعْتُ عَنْ رِحْلَتِكَ الطَّوِيلَة
lines.english: I am Princess Aisha. I have heard about your long journey.
lines.transliteration: ana al-amiiratu aa'isha. sami'tu an rihlatika at-tawiila

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ اللَّه! لَقَدْ تَعَلَّمْتَ كَثِيراً فِي طَرِيقِكَ إِلى هُنا
lines.english: Mashallah! You have learned so much on your way here.
lines.transliteration: maa shaa'allaah! laqad ta'allamta kathiiran fii tariiqika ilaa hunaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُحِبُّ الشِّعْرَ وَالعائِلَة. دَعْنِي أُعَلِّمُكَ كَلِماتِ العائِلَة
lines.english: I love poetry and family. Let me teach you family words.
lines.transliteration: uhibbu ash-shi'ra wal-aa'ila. da'nii u'allimuka kalimaat al-aa'ila

choices.english: Tell me about the royal family

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: العائِلَةُ هِيَ أَساسُ كُلِّ شَيْء. لِنَبْدَأ بِالوالِدَيْن
lines.english: Family is the foundation of everything. Let's start with the parents.
lines.transliteration: al-aa'ilatu hiya asaasu kulli shay'. linabda' bil-waalidayn

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ab — the father, head of the family.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Umm — the mother, heart of the home.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Akh — like my brother who protects me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Did you memorize these words? Let's see!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عَوْدَةٌ جَمِيلَة! لَدَيَّ كَلِماتٌ أُخرى عَنِ العائِلَة
lines.english: A beautiful return! I have more family words for you.
lines.transliteration: awdatun jamiila! ladayya kalimaatun ukhraa an al-aa'ila

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ukht — like me to my brother.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ibn — the son to his father.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Bint — the daughter to her mother.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Tifl — the little one in the family.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let's test what you've learned!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ اللَّه، أَنْتَ تَعْرِفُ كَلِماتٍ كَثِيرَة! لَدَيَّ المَزِيد
lines.english: Mashallah, you know many words! I have more.
lines.transliteration: maa shaa'allaah, anta ta'rifu kalimaatin kathiira! ladayya al-maziid

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Jadd — your father's or mother's father.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Jadda — your father's or mother's mother.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Zawj — the married man, the husband.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Zawja — the married woman, the wife.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ كَلِماتُ الرَّوابِطِ العائِلِيَّة. هَل تَذْكُرُها؟
lines.english: These are the words of family bonds. Do you remember them?
lines.transliteration: haadhihi kalimaatu ar-rawaabit al-aa'iliyya. hal tadhkuruhaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عائِلَتُنا المَلَكِيَّةُ تَحْكُمُ هَذِهِ المَدِينَةَ مُنْذُ أَجْيال
lines.english: Our royal family has ruled this city for generations.
lines.transliteration: aa'ilatunaa al-malakiyya tahkumu haadhihi al-madiinata mundhu ajyaal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَبِي المَلِكُ يَقُولُ: العِلْمُ أَغْلى مِنَ الذَّهَب
lines.english: My father the King says: knowledge is more precious than gold.
lines.transliteration: abii al-maliku yaquul: al-ilmu aghlaa min adh-dhahab

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لِهَذا نُرَحِّبُ بِكُلِّ طالِبِ عِلْمٍ فِي قَصْرِنا
lines.english: That is why we welcome every seeker of knowledge in our palace.
lines.transliteration: li-haadha nurahhibu bikulli taalib ilmin fii qasrinaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome to the palace.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: In the palace we speak formal language.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Morning — the first word in the court.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Evening — time for the royal dinner.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Every morning we read the Quran together.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَبَعدَ الظُّهر دُروس في اللُّغات والتّاريخ
lines.english: And after noon, lessons in languages and history.
lines.transliteration: wa ba'da az-zuhr duruus fii al-lughaat wat-taariikh

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُحِبّ أَن أَتَعَلَّم عَن الشُّعوب الأُخرى
lines.english: I love learning about other peoples.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُريدُ أَن أُسافِر لَكِن أَبي يَقلَق
lines.english: I want to travel but my father worries.
lines.transliteration: uriidu an usaafir laakinn abii yaqlaq

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Vizier Abbas always watches me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحتاج مَن يُوصِل رِسالَة إِلى المَكتَبَة
lines.english: I need someone to deliver a message to the library.
lines.transliteration: ahtaaj man yuusil risaala ilaa al-maktaba

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Can you help me?

personality.catchphrase: بِإِذنِ الله وَبِقُوَّة المَعرِفَة — bi-idhn allaah wa bi-quwwat al-ma'rifa (By God's permission and the power of knowledge)

greeting.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يا مُسافِر. الجَمالُ فِي كُلِّ مَكان
greeting.english: Peace be upon you, traveler. Beauty is everywhere
greeting.transliteration: as-salaamu alayka ya musaafir. al-jamaalu fii kulli makaan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا الشّاعِرُ الرُّومِيّ. أَرى العالَمَ بِالأَلْوانِ وَالكَلِمات
lines.english: I am the Poet Rumi. I see the world in colors and words.
lines.transliteration: ana ash-shaa'iru ar-ruumiyy. araa al-aalama bil-alwaani wal-kalimaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رِحْلَتُكَ كانَتْ طَوِيلَة، لَكِنَّ كُلَّ خُطْوَةٍ رَسَمَتْ لَوْناً فِي قَلْبِكَ
lines.english: Your journey was long, but every step painted a color in your heart.
lines.transliteration: rihlatuka kaanat tawiila, laakinna kulla khutwatin rasamat lawnan fii qalbika

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: دَعْنِي أُعَلِّمُكَ أَلْوانَ القَصْر — فَهِيَ أَلْوانُ الحَياة
lines.english: Let me teach you the colors of the palace — they are the colors of life.
lines.transliteration: da'nii u'allimuka alwaan al-qasr — fahiya alwaanu al-hayaah

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَلْوانُ هِيَ لُغَةُ الرُّوح. اِسْمَعْ وَتَعَلَّمْ
lines.english: Colors are the language of the soul. Listen and learn.
lines.transliteration: al-alwaanu hiya lughatu ar-ruuh. isma' wa ta'allam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Burtuqaaliyy — like the color of the sun at sunset.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَرْدِيّ — كَلَوْنِ الوَرْدِ فِي حَدِيقَةِ القَصْر
lines.english: Wardiyy — like the color of roses in the palace garden.
lines.transliteration: wardiyy — kalawni al-wardi fii hadiiqati al-qasr

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Banafsajiyy — like the color of the sky after sunset.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الآنَ أَخْبِرْنِي: هَلْ حَفِظَ قَلْبُكَ هَذِهِ الأَلْوان؟
lines.english: Now tell me: has your heart memorized these colors?
lines.transliteration: al-aana akhbirnii: hal hafiza qalbuka haadhihi al-alwaan?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدْتَ! كَالقَمَرِ الَّذِي يَعُودُ كُلَّ لَيْلَة. لَدَيَّ أَلْوانٌ وَصِفاتٌ جَدِيدَة
lines.english: You returned! Like the moon that returns every night. I have new colors and descriptions.
lines.transliteration: udta! kal-qamari alladhii ya'uudu kulla layla. ladayya alwaanun wa sifaatun jadiida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Bunniyy — like the color of the good earth.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ramaadiyy — like the color of clouds before rain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَمِيلٌ — وَهَذا ما أَراهُ فِي كُلِّ شَيْء
lines.english: Jamiil — and this is what I see in everything.
lines.transliteration: jamiil — wa haadha maa araahu fii kulli shay'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَبِيحٌ — عَكْسُ الجَمال، لَكِنَّ الشّاعِرَ يَرى الجَمالَ حَتّى فِيه
lines.english: Qabiih — the opposite of beauty, but a poet sees beauty even in it.
lines.transliteration: qabiih — aksu al-jamaal, laakinna ash-shaa'ira yaraa al-jamaala hattaa fiih

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَتَذَكَّرَ هَذِهِ الكَلِمات؟
lines.english: Can you remember these words?
lines.transliteration: hal tastatiiu an tatadkakkara haadhihi al-kalimaat?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنْتَ الآنَ كَالنَّهْرِ الَّذِي يَعْرِفُ طَرِيقَهُ. لَدَيَّ كَلِماتٌ مِنَ القَلْب
lines.english: You are now like a river that knows its path. I have words from the heart.
lines.transliteration: anta al-aana kan-nahri alladhii ya'rifu tariiqahu. ladayya kalimaatun min al-qalb

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sa'iid — like the sun when it rises.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: حَزِينٌ — كَالمَطَرِ الَّذِي يَبْكِي عَلى الأَرْض
lines.english: Haziiin — like the rain that cries upon the earth.
lines.transliteration: haziiin — kal-matari alladhii yabkii alaa al-ard

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Kabiir — like a dream that never ends.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ كَلِماتٌ تَعَلَّمْتَها فِي رِحْلَتِكَ. هَل ما زِلْتَ تَذْكُرُها؟
lines.english: These are words you learned on your journey. Do you still remember them?
lines.transliteration: haadhihi kalimaatun ta'allamtahaa fii rihlatika. hal maa zilta tadhkuruhaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Listen, my friend:

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You traveled far and learned much,

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلُّ كَلِمَةٍ نُورٌ، وَكُلُّ حَرْفٍ طَرِيق
lines.english: Every word is a light, and every letter is a path.
lines.transliteration: kullu kalimatin nuur, wa kullu harfin tariiq

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اَللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ بَحْرٌ عَمِيق، وَأَنْتَ غَوّاصٌ شُجاع
lines.english: The Arabic language is a deep sea, and you are a brave diver.
lines.transliteration: al-lughatu al-arabiyyatu bahrun amiiq, wa anta ghawwaasun shujaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The word is light! Welcome, friend of poetry.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Adjectives are the colors of language.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Red — the color of the rose in the garden.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Green — the color of trees and hope.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Blue — the color of the sky that inspires me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Arabic poetry is older than writing itself.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المُعَلَّقاتُ السَّبع كانَت تُعَلَّق عَلى الكَعبَة
lines.english: The Seven Mu'allaqat were hung on the Kaaba.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلّ بَيت شِعر هُوَ نافِذَة إِلى الرّوح
lines.english: Every verse of poetry is a window to the soul.
lines.transliteration: kullu bayt shi'r huwa naafidha ilaa ar-ruuh

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَيلى حارِسَة الحَديقَة تُحِبّ الشِّعر سِرّاً
lines.english: Leila the garden keeper secretly loves poetry.
lines.transliteration: laylaa haarisat al-hadiiqa tuhibb ash-shi'r sirran

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَأَنا أَكتُب قَصيدَة لِلمَلِك — لَكِن لا تُخبِر أَحَداً
lines.english: And I am writing a poem for the king — but tell no one.
lines.transliteration: wa ana aktub qasiida lil-malik — laakin laa tukhbir ahadan

personality.catchphrase: الكَلِمَة نور — al-kalima nuur (The word is light)

name: Imam Muhammad
role: Teaches verbs of knowledge and final review phrases

greeting.english: In the name of God. Welcome, seeker of knowledge

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا الإِمامُ مُحَمَّد، أُعَلِّمُ فِي مَكْتَبَةِ القَصْر
lines.english: I am Imam Muhammad. I teach in the palace library.
lines.transliteration: ana al-imaamu muhammad, u'allimu fii maktabati al-qasr

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَنَّكَ قَطَعْتَ رِحْلَةً طَوِيلَةً لِتَصِلَ إِلى هُنا
lines.english: I heard that you made a long journey to reach here.
lines.transliteration: sami'tu annaka qata'ta rihlatan tawiila litasila ilaa hunaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اَلْعِلْمُ نُورٌ. وَأَنتَ حَمَلْتَ هَذا النُّورَ مَعَكَ طُولَ الطَّرِيق
lines.english: Knowledge is light. And you have carried this light with you the whole way.
lines.transliteration: al-ilmu nuur. wa anta hamalta haadha an-nuura ma'aka tuula at-tariiq

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: دَعْنِي أُعَلِّمُكَ أَفْعالَ العِلْمِ — أَهَمُّ الأَفْعالِ فِي حَياتِنا
lines.english: Let me teach you the verbs of knowledge — the most important verbs in our lives.
lines.transliteration: da'nii u'allimuka af'aala al-ilmi — ahammu al-af'aali fii hayaatinaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: In the name of God. Let us begin with the verbs of knowledge.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَرَأَ — أَوَّلُ كَلِمَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ السَّماء
lines.english: Qara'a — the first word that came down from the heavens.
lines.transliteration: qara'a — awwalu kalimatin nazalat min as-samaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Kataba — with the pen, knowledge is preserved.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَعَلَّمَ — وَهَذا ما تَفْعَلُهُ أَنتَ الآن
lines.english: Ta'allama — and this is what you are doing right now.
lines.transliteration: ta'allama — wa haadha maa taf'aluhu anta al-aan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ أَساسُ كُلِّ عِلْم. لِنَرَ إِنْ فَهِمْتَ
lines.english: These are the foundation of all knowledge. Let us see if you understood.
lines.transliteration: haadhihi asaasu kulli ilm. linara in fahimta

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّه، عُدْتَ لِلتَّعَلُّم. لَدَيَّ أَفْعالٌ جَدِيدَة
lines.english: Thank God, you returned to learn. I have new verbs.
lines.transliteration: al-hamdu lillaah, udta lit-ta'allum. ladayya af'aalun jadiida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Arafa — knowledge begins with knowing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A'taa — the best of people are those who give.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Saa'ada — and the believer helps his brother.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Amila — for work is worship.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Good. Let us test these verbs.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يا بُنَيَّ، هَذا هُوَ دَرْسُكَ الأَخِير
lines.english: My child, this is your final lesson.
lines.transliteration: ya bunayya, haadha huwa darsuka al-akhiir

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَقَدْ تَعَلَّمْتَ الكَثِير. مِنَ الحُرُوفِ إِلى الكَلِماتِ إِلى الجُمَل
lines.english: You have learned so much. From letters to words to sentences.
lines.transliteration: laqad ta'allamta al-kathiir. min al-huruufi ilaa al-kalimaati ilaa al-jumal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ — قُلْها دائِماً عِنْدَ النِّعْمَة
lines.english: Alhamdulillah — say it always when blessed.
lines.transliteration: al-hamdu lillaah — qulhaa daa'iman inda an-ni'ma

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ma'a as-salaama — for farewell.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Araaka laahiqan — for knowledge never ends.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذا لَيْسَ نِهايَةَ رِحْلَتِكَ. هَذِهِ بِدايَةٌ جَدِيدَة. اِخْتِبارٌ أَخِير!
lines.english: This is not the end of your journey. This is a new beginning. One final test!
lines.transliteration: haadha laysa nihaayata rihlatika. haadhihi bidaayatun jadiida. ikhtibaarun akhiir!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ المَكْتَبَةُ فِيها آلافُ الكُتُبِ بِالعَرَبِيَّة
lines.english: This library contains thousands of books in Arabic.
lines.transliteration: haadhihi al-maktabatu fiihaa aalaaf al-kutubi bil-arabiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Whoever reads opens the doors of the world.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلُّ كِتابٍ هُنا كَنْزٌ. وَأَنتَ الآنَ تَمْلِكُ المِفْتاحَ — اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّة
lines.english: Every book here is a treasure. And you now hold the key — the Arabic language.
lines.transliteration: kullu kitaabin hunaa kanzun. wa anta al-aana tamliku al-miftaaha — al-lughata al-arabiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Praise be to God. Welcome, my child.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Time is a blessing from God. Let us learn.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَوْم — كُلّ يَوم فيهِ خَمس صَلَوات
lines.english: Day — every day has five prayers.
lines.transliteration: yawm — kullu yawm fiihi khams salawaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Night — a time of stillness and reflection.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Morning — time for the dawn prayer.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The mosque is the heart of the village.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Here we pray, learn, and gather.
lines.transliteration: hunaa nusallii wa nata'allam wa najtami'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Knowledge is an obligation for every Muslim.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المُزارِع عُمَر يَحتاج مُساعَدَة في الحَصاد
lines.english: Farmer Omar needs help with the harvest.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And Sheikh Yusuf is preparing a new lesson.

personality.catchphrase: الحَمدُ لِلَّه — al-hamdu lillaah (Praise be to God)
بِسْمِ الله — bismillaah (In God's name)

greeting.arabic: أَهلاً! ريحَة الخُبز الطّازَج أَحلى شَيء
greeting.english: Hello! The smell of fresh bread is the sweetest thing.
greeting.transliteration: ahlan! riihat al-khubz at-taazaj ahlaa shay'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I am Yasmin the baker. Welcome!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَخبُزُ مُنذُ طُفولَتي. الخُبزُ يَجمَع النّاس
lines.english: I have been baking since childhood. Bread brings people together.
lines.transliteration: akhbuzu mundhu tufuulatii. al-khubzu yajma' an-naas

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: In God's name! What shall we cook today?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The kitchen is a school! Let us learn.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Rice — we eat it with everything.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Chicken — the favorite dish in the oasis.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: My mother taught me baking when I was little.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: في رَمَضان نَخبُز طُوال اللَّيل لِلجيران
lines.english: In Ramadan we bake all night for the neighbors.
lines.transliteration: fii ramadaan nakhbuz tuwaal al-layl lil-jiiraan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Imam Muhammad loves my za'atar bread.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالعَشّابَة خَديجَة تَطلُب خُبزاً بِدون مِلح
lines.english: And Herbalist Khadija orders bread without salt.
lines.transliteration: wal-'ashhaaba khadiija tatlub khubzan biduun milh

name: Astronomer Zain
role: Teaches number and sky vocabulary through astronomy

personality.catchphrase: النُّجومُ لا تَكذِب — an-nujuumu laa takdhib (The stars do not lie)

greeting.arabic: النُّجومُ لا تَكذِب. مَرحَباً يا مُتَعَلِّم
greeting.english: The stars do not lie. Welcome, learner.
greeting.transliteration: an-nujuumu laa takdhib. marhaban ya muta'allim

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا زَين. أَدرُسُ النُّجوم مُنذُ عِشرين سَنَة
lines.english: I am Zain. I have studied the stars for twenty years.
lines.transliteration: ana zayn. adrusu an-nujuum mundhu 'ishriina sana

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The Arabs gave the stars their names.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The stars do not lie! What shall we study?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Numbers are the foundation of astronomy.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَجْم — كُلّ نَجم لَهُ اِسم عَرَبي
lines.english: Star — every star has an Arabic name.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Moon — the moon illuminates our nights.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sun — the center of everything.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Al-Khwarizmi invented algebra.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: And the word "algorithm" came from his name.
lines.transliteration: wa kalimat algorithm jaa'at min ismihi

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: العَرَبُ حَفِظوا عِلمَ اليونان وَزادوا عَلَيه
lines.english: The Arabs preserved Greek science and added to it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Tonight the moon is full!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحتاجُ مَن يُساعِدُني في رَصد النُّجوم
lines.english: I need someone to help me observe the stars.
lines.transliteration: ahtaaju man yusaa'idunii fii rasd an-nujuum

name: Carpet Seller Jamal
role: Teaches color vocabulary through carpet trading

personality.catchphrase: يا سلام! — ya salaam! (Oh wow!)

greeting.arabic: يا سلام! تَعال شوف السَّجّاد الجَميل
greeting.english: Oh wow! Come see the beautiful carpets!
greeting.transliteration: ya salaam! ta'aal shuuf as-sajjaad al-jamiil

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا جَمال! أَبيعُ أَجمَل سَجّاد في المَملَكَة
lines.english: I am Jamal! I sell the most beautiful carpets in the kingdom!
lines.transliteration: ana jamaal! abii' ajmal sajjaad fii al-mamlaka

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يا سلام! عِندي سَجّاد جَديد اليَوم
lines.english: Oh wow! I have new carpets today!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Carpets teach you colors!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Yellow — the color of gold and sun.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: White — the color of purity and peace.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Every carpet tells a story.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأُنثوذاتُ تُنسَج بِأَيدي النِّساء في القُرى
lines.english: The patterns are woven by women in the villages.
lines.transliteration: al-unthuzaat tunsaj bi-aydii an-nisaa' fii al-quraa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Layla the spice seller raised her prices!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَكِن عِندي أَسعار أَحسَن. يا سلام!
lines.english: But I have better prices. Oh wow!

name: Dockmaster Nadia
role: Teaches direction vocabulary through port management

personality.catchphrase: بِنِظام! — bi-nizaam! (In order!)

greeting.english: In order! Who are you and what do you want?
greeting.transliteration: bi-nizaam! man anta wa maadha turiid?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا نادِيَة، رَئيسَة المِيناء. كُلّ شَيء يَمُرّ عَبري
lines.english: I am Nadia, dockmaster. Everything passes through me.
lines.transliteration: ana naadiya, ra'iisat al-miinaa'. kullu shay' yamurr 'abrii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: In order! I have little time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: في المِيناء يَجِب أَن تَعرِف الاتِّجاهات
lines.english: In the port you must know directions.
lines.transliteration: fii al-miinaa' yajib an ta'rif al-ittijaahaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Above — the cargo above the ship.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Below — the warehouse below ground.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: This port is three hundred years old.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مِن هُنا خَرَجَت سُفُن إِلى الهِند وَالصّين
lines.english: From here ships departed to India and China.
lines.transliteration: min hunaa kharajat sufun ilaa al-hind was-siin

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هُناكَ سَفينَة بِدون تَصريح. اِذهَب وَتَحَقَّق
lines.english: There is a ship without a permit. Go and check.
lines.transliteration: hunaaka safiina biduun tasriih. idhhab wa tahaqqaq

name: Mountain Hermit Idris
role: Teaches nature vocabulary through mountain wisdom

personality.catchphrase: الجَبَلُ يَعلَم — al-jabalu ya'lam (The mountain knows)

greeting.arabic: الجَبَلُ يَعلَم مَن يَأتي. تَعال اِجلِس
greeting.english: The mountain knows who comes. Come, sit.
greeting.transliteration: al-jabalu ya'lam man ya'tii. ta'aal ijlis

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا إِدريس. أَعيشُ هُنا وَحدي مُنذُ سَنَوات
lines.english: I am Idris. I have lived here alone for years.
lines.transliteration: ana idriis. a'iishu hunaa wahdii mundhu sanawaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The mountain is my teacher and my friend.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The mountain knows... what do you seek?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الطَّبيعَةُ لُغَة بِلا كَلِمات. لَكِن نَحتاج كَلِمات أَيضاً
lines.english: Nature is a language without words. But we need words too.
lines.transliteration: at-tabii'atu lugha bilaa kalimaat. laakin nahtaaj kalimaat aydan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sand — the desert speaks with sand.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Tree — patience is like a tree, it grows slowly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَقولون أَنَّ في هَذا الجَبَل كَنزاً مَخفِيّاً
lines.english: They say there is a hidden treasure in this mountain.
lines.transliteration: yaquuluun anna fii haadha al-jabal kanzan makhfiyyan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: But the real treasure is knowledge.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The mountain tests those who enter.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: If you know the words, you will find the way.

name: Stable Master Yara
role: Teaches animal vocabulary through horse care

personality.catchphrase: هَيّا يا حُصان! — hayyaa ya husaan! (Come on, horse!)

greeting.arabic: هَيّا يا حُصان! أَهلاً يا مُسافِر!
greeting.english: Come on, horse! Hello, traveler!
greeting.transliteration: hayyaa ya husaan! ahlan ya musaafir!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا يارا. أَعتَني بِالخُيول مُنذُ صِغَري
lines.english: I am Yara. I have cared for horses since I was small.
lines.transliteration: ana yaaraa. a'tanii bil-khuyuul mundhu sigharii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let's go! The horses are waiting. What do you want?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Animals are our friends! Let us learn their names.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Horse — the noblest of animals.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Camel — the ship of the desert.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Bird — free in the sky.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحِصانُ العَرَبي أَجمَل سُلالَة في العالَم
lines.english: The Arabian horse is the most beautiful breed in the world.
lines.transliteration: al-hisaanu al-'arabii ajmal sulaala fii al-'aalam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَقولون أَنَّ الله خَلَقَهُ مِن الرّيح
lines.english: They say God created it from the wind.
lines.transliteration: yaquuluun anna allaah khalaqahu min ar-riih

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: A new caravan arrived from the mountain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَقولون إِنَّ الطَّريق خَطير هَذِهِ الأَيّام
lines.english: They say the road is dangerous these days.
lines.transliteration: yaquuluun inna at-tariiq khatiir haadhihi al-ayyaam

personality.catchphrase: الحَديقَة جَنَّة — al-hadiiqa janna (The garden is paradise)

greeting.english: The garden is paradise! Welcome, visitor.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا لَيلى. أَعتَني بِهَذِهِ الحَديقَة مُنذُ عَشر سَنَوات
lines.english: I am Leila. I have tended this garden for ten years.
lines.transliteration: ana laylaa. a'tanii bihaadhihi al-hadiiqa mundhu 'ashr sanawaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The garden is paradise! What shall we discover today?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Nature is a great teacher.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sun — plants need the sun to grow.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Water — and water is also essential.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The first king built this garden.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كانَ يَقول: الحَديقَة تُريح النَّفس وَتُنَقّي الرّوح
lines.english: He used to say: the garden soothes the soul and purifies the spirit.
lines.transliteration: kaana yaquul: al-hadiiqa turiih an-nafs wa tunaqqii ar-ruuh

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الشّاعِر رومي يَجلِس هُنا كُلّ يَوم وَيَكتُب
lines.english: The poet Rumi sits here every day and writes.
lines.transliteration: ash-shaa'ir ruumii yajlis hunaa kulla yawm wa yaktub

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَأَحياناً يَقرَأ لي قَصائِدَهُ. هِيَ جَميلَة
lines.english: And sometimes he reads me his poems. They are beautiful.
lines.transliteration: wa ahyaanan yaqra' lii qasaa'idahu. hiya jamiila

name: Guide Amira
role: Mentor and guide for new travelers

greeting.arabic: أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً يا مُسافِر! أَنا أَميرَة
greeting.english: Welcome, traveler! I am Amira.
greeting.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan ya musaafir! ana amiira

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome, time traveler!
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan ya musaafir az-zaman!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا أَميرَة، مُرشِدَتُكَ في هَذا العالَم
lines.english: I am Amira, your guide in this world.
lines.transliteration: ana amiira, murshidatuka fii haadha al-aalam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَقَد وَصَلتَ إلى واحَة الحُروف — مَكانٌ قَديمٌ مَليءٌ بِأَسرارِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّة
lines.english: You've arrived at the Oasis of Letters — an ancient place full of Arabic language secrets.
lines.transliteration: laqad wasalta ilaa waahat al-huruuf — makaanun qadiimun malii'un bi-asraar al-lugha al-arabiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَخطوطَةٌ سِحرِيَّةٌ نَقَلَتكَ عَبرَ الزَّمَن لِتَتَعَلَّمَ العَرَبِيَّة مِن أَهلِها
lines.english: A magical manuscript brought you through time to learn Arabic from its people.
lines.transliteration: makhtootatun sihriyyatun naqalatka abra az-zaman lita-ta'allama al-arabiyya min ahlihaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لِنَبدَأ بِأَوَّلِ كَلِمَة: مَرْحَبا — وَهِيَ تَعني 'أَهلاً'
lines.english: Let's start with your first word: marhaba — it means 'hello'.
lines.transliteration: linabda' bi-awwal kalima: marhaba — wa hiya ta'nii 'ahlan'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مُمتاز! الآن، اِذهَب إلى الشَّيْخ يوسُف — إنَّهُ عالِمُ القَرية
lines.english: Excellent! Now, go to Scholar Yusuf — he is the village scholar.
lines.transliteration: mumtaaz! al-aan, idh-hab ilaa ash-shaykh yuusuf — innahu aalimu al-qarya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَأَكونُ هُنا دائِماً إذا اِحتَجتَ مُساعَدَة
lines.english: I'll always be here if you need help.
lines.transliteration: sa-akuunu hunaa daa'iman idhaa ihtajta musaa'ada

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَباً مِن جَديد! كَيفَ حالُكَ يا مُسافِر؟
lines.english: Hello again! How are you, traveler?
lines.transliteration: marhaban min jadiid! kayfa haaluka ya musaafir?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: How can I help you?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَكَلَّم مَعَ سُكّانِ القَرية — كُلُّ شَخصٍ يُعَلِّمُكَ كَلِماتٍ جَديدَة
lines.english: Talk to the village residents — each person teaches you new words.
lines.transliteration: takallam ma'a sukkaan al-qarya — kullu shakhsin yu'allimuka kalimaat jadiida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Complete quests to earn XP and dirhams.
lines.transliteration: akmil al-mahaamm litaksib khibra wa daraahim

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلَّما تَعَلَّمتَ كَلِماتٍ أَكثَر، فُتِحَت مَناطِقُ جَديدَة!
lines.english: The more words you learn, the more zones open up!
lines.transliteration: kullama ta'allamta kalimaat akthar, futihat manaatiqu jadiida!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِستَخدِم WASD أَو الأَسهُم لِلتَّحَرُّك. اِضغَط Shift لِلرَّكض!
lines.english: Use WASD or arrow keys to move. Hold Shift to sprint!
lines.transliteration: istakhdim WASD aw al-ashum lit-taharruk. idghat Shift lir-rakd!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِضغَط مَسافَة لِلتَّكَلُّم مَعَ النّاس. اِضغَط Q لِقائِمَة المَهامّ
lines.english: Press Space to talk to people. Press Q for the quest log.
lines.transliteration: idghat masaafa lit-takallum ma'a an-naas. idghat Q li-qaa'imat al-mahaamm

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِضغَط M لِفَتح الخَريطَة وَ ESC لِلقائِمَة الرَّئيسِيَّة
lines.english: Press M to open the map and ESC for the main menu.
lines.transliteration: idghat M lifath al-khariita wa ESC lil-qaa'ima ar-ra'iisiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: واحَةُ الحُروف عالَمٌ سِحرِيٌّ حَيثُ تَتَعَلَّمُ العَرَبِيَّة مِن أَهلِها
lines.english: The Oasis of Letters is a magical world where you learn Arabic from its people.
lines.transliteration: waahat al-huruuf aalamun sihriyyun haythu tata'allamu al-arabiyya min ahlihaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَخطوطَة قَديمَة نَقَلَتكَ إلى هُنا — وَلِكَي تَعودَ يَجِبُ أَن تُتقِنَ اللُّغَة
lines.english: An ancient manuscript brought you here — and to return, you must master the language.
lines.transliteration: makhtootatun qadiima naqalatka ilaa hunaa — wa likay ta'uuda yajib an tutqina al-lugha

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِستَكشِف ثَمانِيَة مَناطِق، تَعَلَّم مِن ثَلاثينَ مُعَلِّماً، وَأَكمِل رِحلَتَك!
lines.english: Explore eight zones, learn from thirty teachers, and complete your journey!
lines.transliteration: istakshif thamaaniyat manaatiq, ta'allam min thalaathiin mu'alliman, wa akmil rihlatak!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَرى أَنَّكَ بَدَأتَ تَستَكشِف! كُلُّ مِنطَقَة تُعَلِّمُكَ مَوضوعاً مُختَلِفاً
lines.english: I see you've started exploring! Each zone teaches you a different topic.
lines.transliteration: araa annaka bada'ta tastakshif! kullu mintaqa tu'allimuka mawduu'an mukhtalifan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المَكتَبَة تُعَلِّم الأَعداد وَالأَلوان، وَالسّوق يُعَلِّم التِّجارَة وَالطَّعام
lines.english: The library teaches numbers and colors, and the market teaches trade and food.
lines.transliteration: al-maktaba tu'allim al-a'daad wal-alwaan, was-suuq yu'allim at-tijaara wat-ta'aam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ اللَّه! أَنتَ تَتَقَدَّمُ بِسُرعَة
lines.english: Wonderful! You are progressing quickly.
lines.transliteration: maa shaa'a allaah! anta tataqaddamu bisur'a

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: واصِل هَكَذا — الطَّريقُ طَويلٌ وَلَكِنَّكَ قادِر
lines.english: Keep it up — the path is long but you are capable.
lines.transliteration: waasil haakadha — at-tariiqu tawiilun wa laakinnaka qaadir

name: Scholar Yusuf
role: Teaches advanced greetings and formal expressions

greeting.english: Welcome to my private study.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً! لَقَد دَخَلتَ مَكاناً خاصّاً
lines.english: Welcome! You have entered a special place.
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! laqad dakhalta makaanan khaassan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Here I keep my most precious books and manuscripts.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let us learn formal greetings.

choices.english: I want to look around first

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدتَ مَرَّة أُخرى! هَل تُريدُ أَن نُكمِل؟
lines.english: You're back again! Shall we continue?
lines.transliteration: udta marratan ukhraa! hal turiidu an nukmil?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Knowledge never ends.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: First: tasharrafnaa — when meeting for the first time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Second: hayyaaka allaah — a noble greeting.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Excellent! You have learned formal greetings.

greeting.english: Hello! Come sit with us.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَباً في بَيتي! هُنا أَعيشُ مَعَ عائِلَتي
lines.english: Welcome to my home! I live here with my family.
lines.transliteration: marhaban fii baytii! hunaa a'iishu ma'a 'aa'ilatii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Do you know family words in Arabic?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Come, let me teach you!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً مَرَّة ثانِيَة! العائِلَة هِيَ كُلّ شَيء
lines.english: Welcome again! Family is everything.
lines.transliteration: ahlan marratan thaaniya! al-'aa'ila hiya kullu shay'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Shall we learn new words?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Umm — this is the most precious word (mother).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ab — the elder man of the house (father).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَخ — مِثل صَديق لَكِن مِنَ الدَّم
lines.english: Akh — like a friend but from blood (brother).
lines.transliteration: akh — mithl sadiiq laakin mina ad-dam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ukht — the girl from the same family (sister).

name: Librarian Ibrahim
role: Teaches numbers and counting in the archives

greeting.english: Welcome to the ancient archives.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنتَ هُنا أَخيراً! قَليلونَ يَصِلونَ إلى هَذا المَكان
lines.english: You are here at last! Few reach this place.
lines.transliteration: anta hunaa akhiiran! qaliiluna yasiluuna ilaa haadha al-makaan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The archives contain the science of numbers.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Do you want to learn counting?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The archives always await you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Every number has a story.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Waahid — the first number (one).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Ithnaan — after one (two).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Thalaatha — a blessed number (three).

name: Spice Seller Layla
role: Teaches spice and food vocabulary in her shop

greeting.english: Welcome to my shop!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يا هَلا! أَنا لَيلى، مَلِكَة البُهارات!
lines.english: Hello! I am Layla, queen of spices!
lines.transliteration: ya halaa! ana laylaa, malikat al-buhaaraat!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: شُمّ هَذِهِ الرَّوائِح! كُلّ واحِدَة لَها اِسم
lines.english: Smell these aromas! Each one has a name.
lines.transliteration: shumm haadhihi ar-rawaa'ih! kullu waahida lahaa ism

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Come, I'll teach you the names of spices and foods.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You're back! Are you hungry?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I have new spices today.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Fulful — it gives food heat (pepper).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Za'faraan — the most expensive spice in the world (saffron).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Khubz — we eat it every day (bread).

greeting.english: Come in! I have the finest textiles.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hello! I am Hassan, the textile trader.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Every fabric has a name and a story.
lines.transliteration: kullu qumaash lahu ism wa qissa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل تُريدُ أَن تَعرِفَ أَسماءَ المَلابِس؟
lines.english: Do you want to know the names of clothing?
lines.transliteration: hal turiidu an ta'rifa asmaa' al-malaabis?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome again, my friend.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: New silk goods have arrived.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Thawb — the traditional garment.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Abaaya — a long, loose cloak.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hidhaa — what we wear on our feet (shoes).

greeting.english: Welcome to my humble home.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Praise God! A guest in my home.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا عُمَر، أَزرَع هَذِهِ الأَرض مُنذُ سِنين
lines.english: I am Omar, I have farmed this land for years.
lines.transliteration: ana 'umar, azra'u haadhihi al-ard mundhu siniin

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let's talk about nature!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: You're back! The land is green today.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sit down and drink some tea.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Shajara — she is the mother of shade (tree).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Maa' — life itself (water).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Shams — it lights everything (sun).

name: Elder Tariq
role: Teaches time-related vocabulary and Bedouin wisdom

greeting.english: Welcome, guest, to my tent.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيكُم! اِجلِس عَلى هَذِهِ السَّجّادَة
lines.english: Peace be upon you! Sit on this carpet.
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu alaykum! ijlis alaa haadhihi as-sajjaada

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الوَقت هُوَ أَثمَن شَيء عِندَ البَدو
lines.english: Time is the most precious thing to the Bedouin.
lines.transliteration: al-waqt huwa athman shay' inda al-badw

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I will teach you the words of time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Time passes like the winds in the desert.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: But there is always time for learning.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sabaah — the first light (morning).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Layl — when the stars appear (night).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Yawm — from sunrise to sunset (day).

greeting.english: Hello! Rest from the journey.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome to my home on the mountain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مِنْ هُنا نَرى كُلّ شَيء — كَبير وَصَغير
lines.english: From here we see everything — big and small.
lines.transliteration: min hunaa naraa kulla shay' — kabiir wa saghiir

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Let's learn how to describe things.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The mountain is beautiful today.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل تُريدُ أَن نَتَعَلَّم صِفات جَديدَة؟
lines.english: Do you want to learn new adjectives?
lines.transliteration: hal turiidu an nata'allam sifaat jadiida?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Kabiir — like the mountain (big).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Saghiir — like the pebbles (small).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Jamiil — like this view (beautiful).

name: Imam Muhammad
role: Teaches spiritual greetings and respectful phrases

greeting.english: Peace and God's mercy be upon you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Welcome to the house of God.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هُنا نَتَعَلَّم الكَلِمات الَّتي تُقَرِّبُنا مِنَ الله
lines.english: Here we learn words that bring us closer to God.
lines.transliteration: hunaa nata'allam al-kalimaat allatii tuqarribunaa mina allaah

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: I will teach you phrases of respect and prayer.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The mosque door is always open.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Come whenever you wish to learn.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: بِسمِ الله — نَقولُها قَبلَ كُلّ شَيء
lines.english: Bismillaah — we say it before everything (in God's name).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّه — شُكر لِلَّه عَلى نِعَمِه
lines.english: Al-hamdu lillaah — thanks to God for His blessings.
lines.transliteration: al-hamdu lillaah — shukr lillaah alaa ni'amihi

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: إِن شاءَ الله — عِندَما نَتَحَدَّث عَنِ المُستَقبَل
lines.english: In shaa' allaah — when we speak about the future (God willing).
lines.transliteration: in shaa' allaah — indamaa natahaddath anil-mustaqbal

name: Captain Rashid
role: Teaches food and drink vocabulary in the tavern

greeting.english: Welcome, new sailor!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً! اِجلِس وَكُل! البَحر يَفتَح الشَّهِيَّة
lines.english: Welcome! Sit and eat! The sea opens the appetite.
lines.transliteration: ahlan! ijlis wa kul! al-bahr yaftah ash-shahiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا رَشيد، كُنتُ قُبطاناً والآن أُطعِم البَحّارَة
lines.english: I am Rashid, I was a captain and now I feed the sailors.
lines.transliteration: ana rashiid, kuntu qubtaanan wal-aan ut'im al-bahhaara

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Do you know the names of foods?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Back at the tavern! Is the belly empty?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Sit down, the food is ready.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Samak — straight from the sea (fish).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Aruzz — the base of every meal (rice).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Shaay — we drink it after eating (tea).

name: Vizier Abbas
role: Teaches formal Arabic and courtly expressions

greeting.english: Who permitted you to enter?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قِف! أَنتَ في قاعَة العَرش المَلَكِيَّة
lines.english: Halt! You are in the Royal Throne Room.
lines.transliteration: qif! anta fii qaa'at al-arsh al-malakiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا الوَزير عَبّاس. هُنا نَتَكَلَّم بِالفُصحى فَقَط
lines.english: I am Vizier Abbas. Here we speak only in formal Arabic.
lines.transliteration: ana al-waziir abbaas. hunaa natakallam bil-fushaa faqat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: إِذا كُنتَ تُريدُ البَقاء، تَعَلَّم كَيفَ تَتَكَلَّم أَمامَ المَلِك
lines.english: If you wish to stay, learn how to speak before the king.
lines.transliteration: idhaa kunta turiidu al-baqaa', ta'allam kayfa tatakallam amaama al-malik

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدتَ مَرَّة أُخرى. أَرجو أَن تَكونَ قَد تَعَلَّمت
lines.english: You return again. I hope you have learned.
lines.transliteration: udta marratan ukhraa. arjuu an takuuna qad ta'allamta

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: The king does not tolerate ignorance.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Hadra — a title of respect for the king (Your Majesty).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Amara — the king's verb: he commanded and we obeyed.
lines.transliteration: amara — fi'l al-malik: amara wa ata'naa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.english: Adl — the most important quality for a ruler (justice).
